Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Temporary contract | Up to 24 months| Belvaux

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
In 2024, LIST and GOODYEAR signed the second phase of their partnership, 2024-2029, building on the outcomes of their previous collaboration and entering new technological areas as well. GOODYEAR-LIST partnership 2.0 embraces Luxembourg's National priorities, such as Sustainability, Digital transformation and Circular economy, through the execution of five Strategic Research Programs: Data Science for Tires, Tire as a Sensor, End-of-Life Tire Valorization, Sustainable Materials for Non-Pneumatic Tires, Sustainable Materials for Next Generation of Pneumatic Tires, Structure-Process-Properties Relationships.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on the fabrication on Li-ion microbatteries. The project is part of a large R&D framework between Goodyear company and LIST including one topic dealing with the development of “smart tires”. In this general context, the main objective of the project in which the postdoctoral candidate will be integrated is to explore how the configuration of an area of microbatteries can be optimally designed to obtain the best coupling with an energy harvester empowering device.
As such, the selected candidate will have (i), to fabricate and characterize solid state microbatterie(s) (ii), explore how to promote their optimal charging when they are powered by an energy harvester, (iii) work on the integration of such devices in a model tire.
More precisely, together with the teams of LIST scientists in the field of materials dry synthesis, microfabrication or microelectronics, the candidate will be involved in the experimental/operational fabrication of the materials needed for the realization of microbatteries, the control of their internal interfaces, their integration for the realization of the microdevices, as well as their structural/chemical characterizations and electrochemical performances determination (ionic conductivity measurement, areal capacity determinations in liquid or solid electrolyte, rate capacity, etc.). He will additionally have to work on the final protection of the fabricated Li-ion microbatteries. The candidate will be located at LIST (Belvaux) and will have regular contacts with the company.

·        You hold a PhD degree with demonstrated theoretical and practical knowledge in Materials science/Material chemistry and Li-ion battery electrochemistry.

·        Proven and mandatory hands-on experience in materials chemistry, Li-ion microbattery fabrication and characterization as well as cleanroom microfabrication.
·        Good experience with structural and chemical characterizations using state-of-the art techniques (SEM, DRX, XPS, etc.)
·        Experience in PVD and/or ALD is a plus.

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)

- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten

title: Associate professor (promotion track) in Banking Law (m/f)
description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg

Job Level: Monolevel

Role Type: Open Position


About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

How to apply
Online application should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to the Dean, Katalin Ligeti
• CV, including periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Statement of future research, teaching and other activities (max 5 pages)
• Short description of the three most important scholarly achievements (max. 2 pages)
• List of publications, research projects acquired, and PhD theses supervised (if applicable)
• List of teaching activities
• Copy of the PhD diploma
• The names, contact information and present position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. We encourage early application. To ensure full consideration, candidates should apply by of 29/04/2026.

• Contract Type: Academic - Permanent. This position is tenured and promotion to Full Professor is possible after 5 years upon positive evaluation

• Planned Start Date: 01.09.2026
• Location: Kirchberg Campus

title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

title: PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
PHD IN SPIN PHOTON ENTANGLEMENT GENERATION WITH COLOUR CENTRES IN SILICON CARBIDE (m/f)

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

Vous évoluez depuis plusieurs années dans le secteur immobilier luxembourgeois et disposez d'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la promotion immobilière. Votre parcours vous a permis d'acquérir une vision globale d'une opération immobilière, que ce soit au sein d'un promoteur immobilier ou à travers des fonctions de pilotage de projets complexes dans le secteur de la construction ou du développement immobilier.

Finegan Luxembourg fait partie du groupe Finegan, un cabinet de conseil français indépendant fondé en 2009. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations en favorisant innovation, proximité et engagement à long terme.

Finance

• Normes IFRS appliquées aux instruments financiers.

Data & Outils Quantitatifs

• SAS.
• R.
• Python.
• MATLAB.
• Outils de modélisation et d'analyse statistique.

Compétences comportementales

• Leadership et capacité à fédérer les équipes.
• Excellent sens de la communication et de la relation client.
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
• Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation résultats.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
• Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements exigeants et en constante évolution.
• Aptitude à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets stratégiques.

Compétences linguistiques

• Français, lu, écrit et parlé.

• Intervenir sur des projets stratégiques à forte valeur ajoutée.

• Fluency in English; French and/or German would be considered an asset.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung

- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)

title: Consultant BI (m/f)
description:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités SAP, Business Intelligence et Data, Bmatix recherche un(e) Consultant(e) SAP BI / Data Science & IA.

La particularité de ce profil réside à combiner de solides compétences dans l'écosystème SAP Business Intelligence avec des compétences en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions :

En fonction des projets et des besoins de nos clients, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes étapes de la chaîne Data :

SAP Business Intelligence

• Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions BI dans l'environnement SAP.
• Intervenir sur SAP BW/4HANA et SAP BusinessObjects.
• Concevoir et maintenir des rapports et tableaux de bord avec SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (WebI).
• Participer à la modélisation et à la structuration des données.
• Utiliser SAP Information Design Tool pour la conception et la gestion des univers.
• Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions BI.
• Participer à l'amélioration et à l'optimisation des solutions de reporting existantes.

Data Engineering & ETL

• Participer à l'extraction, la transformation et l'intégration des données.
• Travailler sur des environnements SAP Data Services et SSIS.
• Manipuler différentes bases de données : MySQL et SQL Server.
• Préparer et nettoyer les données nécessaires aux analyses.
• Participer à la mise en place de flux de données fiables et exploitables.

Data Science & Machine Learning

• Explorer et analyser des jeux de données complexes.
• Préparer et transformer les données pour les modèles analytiques.
• Développer des modèles de Machine Learning.
• Participer à des travaux de prédiction, classification, régression et optimisation.
• Utiliser les bibliothèques Python dédiées à la Data Science et au Machine Learning.
• Évaluer les performances des modèles et interpréter les résultats.
• Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'Intelligence Artificielle dans les problématiques métiers de nos clients.

Data Analytics & Visualisation

• Réaliser des analyses statistiques et exploratoires.
• Identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations pertinentes dans les données.
• Construire des visualisations permettant de faciliter la compréhension et l'exploitation des données.
• Participer à la conception de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de performance.
• Utiliser Power BI ainsi que les outils de visualisation Python.

Votre profil :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Business Intelligence, Informatique, Statistiques ou dans un domaine similaire.

Vous disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle significative dans les domaines de la BI, de la Data/ de l'IA.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable de comprendre les problématiques métiers et de faire le lien entre données, outils BI et technologies Data/IA.

Au-delà de la maîtrise des différents outils, votre valeur ajoutée réside dans une double approche SAP BI et Data Science / IA.
Vous devez comprendre les problématiques traditionnelles de Business Intelligence et de reporting, tout en ayant une vision plus large des possibilités offertes par la Data Science, le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance
• Teach in core areas of banking law. The ability to contribute to teaching in related areas of commercial law—such as financial and securities law, company law, insolvency law, the law of commercial contracts and torts - is an asset
• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres
• Engage with Luxembourg and EU regulators (e.g. CSSF, CBL, ECB, ESMA), international organizations, e.g. IOSCO, BIS, FSB, etc., and other stakeholders, e.g. (inter )national law firms, industry and academic associations
• Acquire competitive research funding and establish and lead their own research team
• Show and develop leadership potential
The candidate will join one of Europe's most prominent academic groups in banking and financial law, distinguished by both its intellectual strength and research output. They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Their doctoral students will benefit from a strong academic environment and excellent career prospects—more than 20 former PhD graduates from the Department have gone on to become professors.

Your profile
• A Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD degree in Law
• Experience and interest in engaging in academic research at the highest level
• Publications in internationally recognized journals, monographs with international publishers or other publications in banking law (or other fields of financial law) indicating potential for excellent research
• Potential and aptitude for teaching and supervising research at the university level
• An excellent academic track record demonstrating both scholarly excellence and leadership potential
• Experience with externally funded research projects and interdisciplinarity is considered to be an asset
• Experience in interdisciplinary research—particularly at the intersection of law, finance, and technology—is a strong asset
The successful candidate must commit to lecturing banking law, as well as related topics in financial and commercial law, at bachelor and master levels.
The successful candidate is also expected to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, prepare grant applications for external funding and actively engage with other research institutions and industry partners to establish research cooperations in Luxembourg and beyond.
Language requirements:
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and French. Knowledge of German is considered an advantage. The University actively supports language development among its staff and offers access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research-Intensive Universities.
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs
• Attractive salary and benefits packages with excellent opportunities for external funding. Support for career development and mentoring. Services to promote staff well-being and a healthy work-life balance

description:
Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, AMXL EU Supply Chain Execution

Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and as cost effectively as possible.
Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.

Key job responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network

A day in the life

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.

About the team

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

- Experience working with databases and SQL
- Experience in project or program management
- Experience with operations/supply chain
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

We see a world of opportunity. From uncovering ways to digitalize, to enabling new sectors to take off, to building sustainability and resilience into economies, we know insights reveal new opportunities for all.

We are diverse and dedicated problem solvers, part of the worldwide network of high-quality audit, tax and advisory services.

Right now, we have more than 1800 employees from over 70 nationalities. Join our growing group of young and youthful innovators to uncover a world of opportunity together.

We are seeking our future Junior Auditors - Starting in January 2027 (m/f/d)

We act in the public interest and the capital market, and we are committed to delivering quality audits, enabled by the power of technology and the strength of our people.  By leveraging leading technologies, we are transforming the audit experience for our professionals and our clients - enabling us to provide an even higher quality audit by increasing our ability to focus on the issues that matter through the data and insights it provides.  

What your responsibilities and challenges will be

• Provide audit services to a variety of companies and have the opportunity to develop your skills in IFRS and local GAAP
• Participate in audit and accounting projects serving both domestic and global clients across diverse industries such as banking, insurance, asset management, real estate, private equity or CIPS (commercial industries & public sector)
• Gain solid audit, financial and accounting knowledge
• Build trust with clients and create a strong relationship with them
• Work in an international environment where the business language is English
• Work in multicultural teams with people from diverse backgrounds and countries

What you will be working on

As a junior you will:  

• Bridge the gap between your theoretical expertise and the practical implications of emerging global accounting standards and international mandates, cultivating a profound mastery of standards like IFRS and local GAAP
• Work on a diversified portfolio of international clients and meet them (face-to-face or virtually)
• Learn how a wide variety of organizations are working, including reviewing their systems and processes to be able to advise the companies that you will audit
• Give stakeholders confidence by reviewing the financial statements of a company
• Execute our audit approach, which involves evaluating the client's operational landscape, appraising risk factors and internal control structures, conducting financial statement audits, and formulating targeted suggestions and specialized reports
• Be a part of innovative projects to improve our processes and tools

What we look for 

Effective auditors possess a combination of technical and soft skills, including:

• Qualification: you hold a bachelor/master's degree or you are about to graduate soon in either audit, accounting, finance or engineering / IT, and you are interested in undertaking professional accountancy qualifications (e.g. IRE)
• Analytical skills: the ability to analyze financial data, identify anomalies, and assess the financial health of an organization
• Attention to detail: a keen eye for accuracy and a commitment to thorough documentation and review
• Communication skills: effective verbal and written communication skills to build and maintain excellent relationships with clients and teams, and the ability to work on your own initiative and as part of a team
• Ethical integrity: a strong commitment to ethical conduct and independence to maintain the credibility of the audit process
• Problem-solving: the capacity to identify and resolve complex financial issues and discrepancies
• Time management: efficiently manage multiple engagements and meet deadlines
• Language skills: you are fluent in English, any other language would be an asset

What you will get 

KPMG is where you will find the right opportunities to advance your career and the widest available range of possibilities so you can grow professionally. Make a real impact, join a diverse team of leading experts, work with global clients, and discover technological solutions.

title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events

Education
• Master's degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline relevant to environmental sustainability, such as: industrial ecology, environmental engineering, environmental or ecological economics or computational social science
• Solid academic grounding in Planetary Boundaries, Doughnut Economics, Post Growth or degrowth literature
• Familiarity with Decent Living Standards and Quality of Life frameworks

Experience and skills

title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with DFT codes (e.g. VASP, CRYSTAL, Quantum ESPRESSO or similar), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of magnetism, ferroelectricity and/or multiferroics is a strong asset.
• You are fluent in English, both oral and written. Knowledge of French is an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio

- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung

- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

description:
Failure Analysis Engineer (Test) Wij zijn op zoek naar een Failure Analysis Engineer die enthousiast is over het achterhalen van de kernoorzaak van technische problemen en het continu verbeteren van processen in een dynamische, internationale werkomgeving. Heb jij een technische achtergrond, maar steek je ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen aan machines? Dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou! Werkzaamheden Uitvoeren van Root Cause Analyses (RCA) op complexe elektronische en mechatronische systemen die retour komen van klanten of vanuit onze interne productie. Jouw bevindingen zijn essentieel voor het kwaliteitsteam bij het definiëren van verbeteringen en het oplossen van faalmodi. Samenwerken met kwaliteits-, ontwikkelings- en productieafdelingen om problemen op te lossen en de betrouwbaarheid van producten te verbeteren. Verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en implementeren van containmentmaatregelen om non-conforme producten te beheren en een soepele productieflow te ondersteunen. Vertalen van jouw analyses naar concrete verbeteracties voor toekomstige productontwikkeling en procesoptimalisatie. Arbeidsvoorwaarden 25 betaalde vakantiedagen (exclusief nationale feestdagen) Flexibele werktijden Gratis toegang tot de bedrijfsfitness Dagelijks gratis lunch, diner en gezonde snacks op locatie beschikbaar Wat levert deze baan jou op? Veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling met een individueel leer- en groeiplan Uitgebreide doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen diverse functies en projecten Wat breng jij mee? Een bachelor (BSc of BEng) in Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Een sterk analytisch vermogen en een oplossingsgerichte mentaliteit. Een scherpe blik voor detail en een praktische instelling. Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en het nemen van eigenaarschap over jouw werk. Een echte teamspeler met focus op gezamenlijke doelen. Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Oprechte interesse in

elektronica en productkwaliteit. Hier kom je te werken Bij onze klant ontwerpen en produceren we geavanceerde technologie die industrieën aandrijft en de wereld met elkaar verbindt. description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines krisenfesten Unternehmens mit der Dynamik eines modernen E-Commerce- und Logistikumfelds.

In der Rolle unterstützen Sie den Aufbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke von Anfang an mit. Statt bestehende Strukturen zu verwalten, entwickeln Sie als Dienstleister für die Apotheke neue Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Sortimentsstrategien und Wachstumsfelder für ein Geschäftsfeld mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung.

Das bewirken Sie bei uns

Als Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für ausgewählte Sortimentsbereiche der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Sortimentsstrategie:  Sie bauen unsere pharmazeutischen Sortimente im eCommerce kontinuierlich auf und identifizieren neue Umsatz-, Markt- und Wachstumspotenziale zur Etablierung auf dem Markt
- Lieferantenentwicklung:  Sie bauen strategische Partnerschaften auf, entwickeln erste Kooperationen weiter und gestalten die zukünftige Lieferantenstruktur aktiv mit
- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft
- Preisstrategie:  Sie analysieren Markt-, Sortiments- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus fundierte Preis- und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation:  Ihre Basis ist ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung:  Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf, Category Management oder im Lieferantenmanagement mit und haben bereits Verantwortung für Sortimente, Umsatz- oder Geschäftsentwicklung übernommen
- Branchenverständnis:   Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrungen im Pharma-, Healthcare-, Apotheken-, Handels- oder FMCG-Umfeld
- Verhandlungsgeschick:  Sie überzeugen durch eine hohe Abschlussstärke und haben Erfahrung in der Führung anspruchsvoller Lieferanten- und Vertragsverhandlungen
- Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

Over AA Schroefpalen

AA Schroefpalen is gespecialiseerd in trillingsvrije funderingsoplossingen. Vanuit onze vestiging in Malden realiseren wij funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland.

Met moderne funderingsmachines, graafmachines en digitaal boormanagement zorgen wij voor een veilige, efficiënte en nauwkeurige uitvoering van onze projecten.

AA Schroefpalen is onderdeel van de Possehl Group en werkt nauw samen met de Duitse zusteronderneming JACBO Pfahlgründungen GmbH.

Bij ons vind je korte lijnen, een nuchtere werksfeer en collega’s die zeggen wat ze doen en doen wat ze zeggen.

Ben jij thuis op een 16-tons graafmachine?

Voor onze funderingsprojecten zoeken wij een ervaren graafmachinist voor een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine.

Je werkt direct samen met de boormachinist, funderingswerkers en uitvoerder en zorgt ervoor dat de bouwplaats rondom de funderingswerkzaamheden goed voorbereid, veilig en efficiënt blijft.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met grondverzet, het voorbereiden en onderhouden van de werkplek, het verplaatsen van materiaal en het ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg.

Je weet wat een machine kan, werkt gecontroleerd en houdt voortdurend rekening met collega’s, andere machines en werkzaamheden in jouw omgeving.

Jouw werkzaamheden

- Veilig en zelfstandig bedienen van een circa 16-tons rupsgraafmachine;
- Uitvoeren van grondverzet op funderingsprojecten;
- Egaliseren en voorbereiden van werkterreinen;
- Vrijmaken en toegankelijk houden van de werkplek rondom de funderingsmachine;
- Verplaatsen van grond en bouwmaterialen;
- Ondersteunen van de funderingsploeg tijdens de uitvoering;
- Voorbereiden van locaties voor het aanbrengen van funderingspalen;
- Werken volgens tekeningen, maatvoering en aanwijzingen van de uitvoerder;
- Veilig werken rondom funderingsmachines, vrachtwagens en ander zwaar materieel;
- Uitvoeren van de dagelijkse machinecontrole en LMRA;
- Controleren van hydrauliek, rupsen, bakken, snelwissel en andere aanbouwdelen;
- Signaleren van slijtage, schade en storingen;
- Uitvoeren van dagelijks onderhoud en kleine werkzaamheden aan de machine;
- Zorgdragen voor een veilige, nette en goed georganiseerde werkplek.

Waar jij blij van wordt

- Een passend salaris (cao Bouw & Infra), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
- Een contract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
- 45 vrije dagen per jaar;
- Uitbetaling van overuren of compensatie in vrije tijd;
- Vergoeding van reisuren en toepasselijke toeslagen volgens de geldende bedrijfsregeling;
- Een moderne graafmachine en goed onderhouden materieel;
- Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
- Afwisselende funderingsprojecten door heel Nederland;
- Een klein en betrokken team;
- Korte communicatielijnen;
- Een collegiale en nuchtere werksfeer;
- Cursussen, opleidingen en doorgroeimogelijkheden;
- Mogelijkheid om benodigde certificaten via AA Schroefpalen te behalen;
- Werkkleding, veiligheidsschoenen en persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen van de zaak.

Waar wij blij van worden

- Ervaring als graafmachinist, bij voorkeur op rupsgraafmachines in de klasse van circa 14–18 ton;
- Ervaring in de bouw, infra, grondverzet of funderingstechniek is een pré;
- Je hebt gevoel voor machines en werkt nauwkeurig;
- Technisch inzicht en basiskennis van mechaniek en hydrauliek;
- Een geldig VCA-certificaat en TCVT certificaat of de bereidheid om dit via ons te behalen;
- Rijbewijs B; rijbewijs BE, C of CE is een pré;

- Je kunt goed samenwerken met boormachinisten, funderingswerkers en uitvoerders;
- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal voldoende om veilig te kunnen werken en instructies te begrijpen;
- Je bent flexibel inzetbaar op projecten door heel Nederland;
- Incidenteel overnachten voor een project is voor jou bespreekbaar.

Vakmanschap, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en motivatie zijn voor ons belangrijker dan een perfect passend cv.

title: Zorgkundige bij revalidatiecentrum Plataan in Heerlen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Sevagram een Zorgkundige bij revalidatiecentrum Plataan in Heerlen

Werk jij als zorgkundige in België en ben je toe aan meer ruimte, meer inspraak en werk dat echt verschil maakt? Net over de grens ligt bij Plataan in Heerlen een nieuwe stap voor je klaar. Hier werk je niet alleen voor mensen, maar vooral met mensen. Je kijkt naar wat iemand nog zelf kan, waar iemand naartoe wil en hoe jij kunt helpen om die volgende stap mogelijk te maken.

Revalidatie met de volgende stap voor ogen

Plataan is een moderne locatie voor geriatrische revalidatie en kortdurende zorg. Onze cliënten komen bijvoorbeeld na een operatie, ziekenhuisopname of ziekte om te herstellen, sterker te worden en weer zoveel mogelijk zelf te kunnen doen.
Niet iedereen volgt dezelfde route. De een gaat daarna naar huis, de ander naar een andere zorglocatie of heeft extra ondersteuning nodig op lichamelijk, cognitief of psychisch gebied.
Wat de volgende stap ook is: bij Plataan help jij iemand om daar zo zelfstandig mogelijk naartoe te groeien.

Jouw rol in het herstel

Als Zorgkundige ben je dichtbij. Je herkent de client, ziet wat er verandert en weet wanneer je moet stimuleren, ondersteunen of juist ruimte moet geven. Je:

  • Ondersteunt bij de persoonlijke verzorging en dagelijkse activiteiten en zorgt voor een veilige, warme omgeving
  • Stimuleert cliënten om zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en begeleidt hen bij hun herstel en revalidatie
  • Hebt oog voor welzijn, zelfvertrouwen en kwaliteit van leven en ziet wanneer iemand extra ondersteuning nodig heeft
  • Signaleert veranderingen, bespreekt deze met collega’s en werkt nauw samen met verzorgenden, verpleegkundigen en andere disciplines.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Een diploma zorgkundige
  • Motivatie om te werken in een betrokken en professionele omgeving
  • Zin om samen te werken en jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen

De stap naar werken in Nederland lijkt misschien groot, maar je staat er niet alleen voor.

Wij begeleiden je stap voor stap bij:

  • Erkenning van je diploma (indien nodig)
  • Aanvragen van een BSN
  • Praktische zaken rondom werken als grensarbeider

Zo kun jij je focussen op wat echt belangrijk is: goede zorg leveren.

title: Verpleegkundige bij revalidatie locatie Plataan in Heerlen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Sevagram een Verpleegkundige bij revalidatie locatie Plataan in Heerlen

De weg naar herstel begint hier en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. Revalidatie is meer dan behandelen en verzorgen, het gaat om kleine stappen die samen een groot verschil maken. Jij helpt mensen weer vooruit.

Revalidatie met een duidelijk doel

Bij Plataan in Heerlen komen cliënten tijdelijk bij ons om te herstellen, te revalideren of weer grip te krijgen op hun dagelijks leven. Bijvoorbeeld na een operatie, een acute gezondheidsverandering of wanneer iemand tijdelijk intensieve medische en verpleegkundige ondersteuning nodig heeft. Op locatie Plataan is geen dag hetzelfde.

Jouw rol in het herstel

Als verpleegkundige ben jij een belangrijke schakel binnen het revalidatieteam. Je combineert een scherpe verpleegkundige blik met aandacht voor de persoon achter de zorgvraag. Je weet wanneer je moet handelen, maar ook wanneer je iemand juist de ruimte geeft om het zelf te proberen.

  • Aandacht & Verpleegtechniek: Je voert complexe verpleegtechnische handelingen uit en bewaart het overzicht bij acute medische of veranderende situaties op de afdeling.
  • Echt luisteren: Je kijkt voorbij de medische diagnose. Je leert de mens achter de client kennen, stelt hen gerust en biedt een veilige omgeving in een vaak onzekere periode.
  • Samenwerken met korte lijnen: Je werkt nauw samen met de specialist ouderengeneeskunde, behandelaren en naasten. Jouw observaties en inbreng zijn onmisbaar in het behandelproces.
  • Elke dag een beetje beter: Je denkt graag actief mee over hoe we onze zorg en ons werkplezier op de afdeling steeds verder kunnen verbeteren.

Je bent een verpleegkundige die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van een omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.

  • Je hebt een afgerond diploma MBO-4 of HBO Verpleegkunde en een geldige BIG registratie
  • Je hebt een warm hart voor ouderen en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving waar klinische zorg en welzijn hand in hand gaan.
  • Je blijft kalm en gestructureerd als het druk is, en weet met jouw positieve energie rust te brengen op de afdeling.
  • Je past binnen onze Planetree visie: je werkt vanuit vertrouwen, oprechtheid en met een menselijk inzicht.

title: (Senior) Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een (Senior) Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen

Regie voeren, adviseren en impact maken: jij zorgt dat vergunningaanvragen soepel verlopen en initiatieven verder kunnen.

Als (Senior) Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen inwoners, ondernemers, collega’s en bestuur. Je begeleidt vergunningaanvragen en initiatieven van begin tot eind en zorgt dat iedereen weet waar hij aan toe is. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de aanvraag: je denkt mee, adviseert en zoekt naar oplossingen die passen binnen de regels én bij wat er in de praktijk nodig is.

Je krijgt te maken met uiteenlopende aanvragen en ruimtelijke vraagstukken. De ene keer beoordeel je een aanvraag vanuit de Omgevingswet, de andere keer begeleid je een ondernemer bij een gevelverbeteringsplan of sluit je aan bij de omgevingstafel om een initiatief integraal af te stemmen. Met jouw kennis, overzicht en gevoel voor de omgeving draag je bij aan een goede inwoners- en ondernemersbeleving in Sittard-Geleen. Samen gaan we Veerkrachtig Vooruit.

We zoeken een Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen en staan open voor verschillende niveaus van ervaring. Ben je een ervaren casemanager, werk je al op senior niveau of zit je daar nog tussenin? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. We kijken naar jouw kennis, ervaring en ontwikkelpotentieel en bespreken graag samen welke rol en verantwoordelijkheid het beste bij jou passen.

Veerkrachtig Vooruit

Als (Senior) Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen maak je deel uit van Team Vergunningen, Parkeren, Markten & Havens. Binnen het team werken ongeveer 40 collega’s samen aan een goede dienstverlening voor inwoners en ondernemers. Binnen de unit Omgevingsvergunningen houden collega’s zich bezig met verschillende soorten vergunningen en aanvragen op het gebied van onder andere de Omgevingswet, de Algemene plaatselijke verordening en bijzondere wetten.

De sfeer is open, positief en betrokken. We helpen elkaar wanneer dat nodig is, vullen elkaar aan bij lastige vraagstukken en vieren samen de resultaten. Want goede vergunningverlening gaat niet alleen over regels en procedures. Het gaat ook over luisteren, meedenken en zorgen dat inwoners en ondernemers weten waar ze aan toe zijn.

Jouw werk maakt direct verschil in de gemeente. Je helpt initiatieven verder, bewaakt de kwaliteit van vergunningtrajecten en draagt bij aan een positieve inwoners- en ondernemersbeleving. Je krijgt hier de ruimte om te groeien, initiatief te nemen en iedere dag bij te dragen aan een gemeente die menselijker, duurzamer en een beetje beter wordt. Dát is Veerkrachtig Vooruit.

Wat jou veerkrachtig maakt:

Je krijgt energie van afwisseling en van een rol waarin je zelf de regie neemt. Je houdt overzicht, denkt in mogelijkheden en weet verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de regels en de bestuurlijke context niet uit het oog. Je bent duidelijk in je communicatie, werkt graag samen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het resultaat.

Herken jij jezelf ook in de volgende zaken? Dan kunnen we niet wachten om je te leren kennen!

  • Je beschikt over minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in planologie, juridisch of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van vergunningtrajecten en het adviseren over ruimtelijke vraagstukken
  • Je bent resultaatgericht, gestructureerd en houdt de voortgang scherp in de gaten
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet wanneer je zelfstandig handelt of juist de samenwerking zoekt
  • Je bent omgevingsbewust en hebt gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen en verschillende belangen
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder uitleggen aan inwoners, ondernemers en andere betrokkenen
  • Je kent de relevante wet- en regelgeving, waaronder de Omgevingswet, en vindt het interessant om ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied te volgen.
