Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

Ønsker du en meningsfylt jobb med varierte og utfordrende oppgaver, er Ålesund kommune et spennende alternativ.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

title: Sous Chef, O´Conners Stavanger
description:
🍀 Sous Chef Wanted – O’Connor’s Irish Pub, Stavanger

Full-time | Start ASAP | 1–2 month trial through Staffers | Permanent opportunity

Are you an experienced chef ready to take more responsibility in the kitchen?

O’Connor’s Irish Pub Stavanger is looking for an experienced and reliable Sous Chef to join their team as soon as possible.

The position will initially be a 1–2 month full-time assignment through Staffers, giving both you and the restaurant the opportunity to make sure it’s a great match. If everything works well, the plan is for you to move into a permanent position directly with O’Connor’s after the trial period.

Located in the heart of Stavanger, O’Connor’s combines the atmosphere of a traditional Irish pub with a busy social environment and a kitchen serving classic, hearty pub food.

👨‍🍳 The role

As Sous Chef, you’ll play an important role in the daily operation of the kitchen.

You’ll work closely with the rest of the kitchen team, take responsibility during service and help make sure the kitchen runs smoothly, efficiently and consistently.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking responsibility for the kitchen and service when required
  • Preparing and cooking dishes according to the restaurant’s menu and standards
  • Managing your own section during busy services
  • Supporting and guiding other members of the kitchen team
  • Organising mise en place and preparation
  • Helping maintain good structure and workflow in the kitchen
  • Ensuring high standards of quality, cleanliness and food safety
  • Keeping calm and organised during busy periods
  • Cooperating closely with both the kitchen and front-of-house teams
  • Supporting the Head Chef and contributing to the overall operation of the kitchen

🔎 We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has solid professional experience as a chef
  • Ideally has previous experience as a Sous Chef, Senior Chef or Chef de Partie with additional responsibility
  • Is confident taking responsibility during service
  • Can work independently and make decisions when needed
  • Is organised, reliable and takes ownership of their work
  • Works efficiently without compromising quality
  • Is comfortable working in a busy, high-volume kitchen
  • Has a positive attitude and works well with others
  • Can communicate comfortably in English or Norwegian
  • Is available to start as soon as possible
  • Is interested in a long-term opportunity if the role is a good match

Experience from pub food, casual dining, à la carte or high-volume kitchens is a strong advantage.

⭐ What’s on offer?

  • Start as soon as possible
  • An initial 1–2 month trial period through Staffers
  • Clear opportunity to be hired directly by O’Connor’s after the trial period
  • A senior role with responsibility in the kitchen
  • A lively workplace in central Stavanger
  • A well-established restaurant and hospitality group
  • The opportunity to show what you can do before both sides commit long-term

📍 Location

  • O’Connor’s Irish Pub – Stavanger

title: Service Engineer- SeaQ Control
description:
VARD Electro is shaping the future of shipbuilding through advanced electrical, automation and integrated technology solutions. Through our SeaQ portfolio, we support our customers worldwide with reliable, intelligent systems that enhance safety, connectivity, and operational performance at sea.

Our Service Department is expanding, and we are looking for a Service Engineer in the SeaQ Control field to join us! SeaQ Control is VARD Electro's automation platform for monitoring and controlling vessel systems. The solution integrates alarm, monitoring and control functions and plays a key role in the safe and efficient operation of advanced vessels worldwide. You will join a specialized and collaborative environment where different disciplines come together to deliver cutting-edge solutions for the global maritime industry.

At VARD we care about nurturing talents and embracing diverse strengths, giving everyone the opportunity to develop and grow. Join us and be part of a community that celebrates your skills, and where together we are shaping the future of shipbuilding. 


Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will play a key role in the commissioning and service of our SeaQ Control systems delivered to customers worldwide. You will work hands-on with advanced automation and control systems, both on board vessels and in-house, contributing to projects that ensure safe and efficient vessel operations.
Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and providing technical assistance to customers and colleagues. You will also participate in factory testing, reporting, and other in-house support activities.
This position involves extensive travel, and we are looking for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys solving technical challenges, works well independently, and has a strong customer-focused mindset.

Qualifications
  • Technical background/education within Automation (Technician Level/ Bachelor/ Master)
  • Experience from commissioning, service, troubleshooting or maintenance of automation and control systems
  • Strong competence in PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial networks and instrumentation

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong technical understanding and interest 
  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Customer-oriented mindset and professional communication skills
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian and English
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Norwegian driver's license
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • Geographical / rotation flexibility
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with VARD Social you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003

title: Norlandia Marsvegen barnehage søker kokk/assistent
description:
Norlandia Marsvegen barnehage er en flott barnehage med 6 baser. Barnehagen ligger sentralt på Tomasjord, med gangavstand til skog, ball-løkker, akebakker, skiløyper, idrettshaller, bibliotek mm. Idrett er bærebjelken i det pedagogiske arbeidet. Aktivitetene skjer med utgangspunkt i Norlandia barnehagenes visjon” med livslang lyst til lek og læring”, barnas medbestemmelse og skal fremme både fysiske og psykiske helse. Fellesskap-mestring-aktivitetsglede er viktig for oss.

  • Er nysgjerrig og undrende med barna

  • Bidrar systematisk og strukturert med å utvikle pedagogisk kvalitet

  • Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsferdigheter

  • Støtter opp under et leke- og læringsmiljø som innbyr til undring og utforsking, lek og læring

  • Liker å jobbe selvstendig, men også i en del av et felleskap

  • Liker en aktiv og variert hverdag

Som assistent hos oss vil du få:

  • Faglig utviklende arbeidsmiljø

  • Introduksjonsprogram for nyansatte

  • Muligheter for faglig nettverk i regi av Norlandia

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn og pensjonsordninger

  • Felles samlinger og plandager i regi av Norlandia

  • Ressursbank for alle ansatte med tilgang til materiell, elektroniske verktøy og støttesystemer

  • Bedriftsavtale med Sats

Kokk som lager varm, næringsrik, god og variert lunsj hver dag

Formelle kvalifikasjonskrav:

  • Utenlandske søkere må ha Bergenstest og godkjent utdanning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse

  • Godkjent politiattest, ikke eldre enn 3 måneder må vises ved tiltredelse

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Norlandia Barnehagene er vårt mål er at alle barn skal ha et likeverdig tilbud og gå i en høykvalitetsbarnehage. Nøkkelen til det er kompetente ansatte som er omsorgsfulle og utviklingsorienterte, derfor deler vi kunnskap med hverandre og er stolte av arbeidsplassen vår.

Vi baserer vårt arbeid på kunnskap og innovasjon, som omhandler at vår praksis utvikler seg i tråd med ny forskning og erfaring. God ledelse, felles kultur og standard, samt et rikt leke- og læringsmiljø er viktig for barna, og for oss.

Derfor har vi valgt ut noen felles satsningsområder som vi vet har stor betydning for barns utvikling og progresjon. Vi jobber helthetlig og systematisk med intern kompetanseutvikling og ekstern barnehagevurdering med blant annet CLASS som verktøy.

title: Full-time Driver Alnabru
description:
We’re looking for Full-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B): You have held your license for at least 2 years from the date of issue and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Full-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: We're looking for our next great team members to join us this November, with planned start dates in weeks 45-47.

  • Working Hours:

    • Morning shifts: start between 05:15 and 06:00

    • Evening shift: start between 13:15 and 14:00

  • Position: 100% Full-time

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds vei 1, 0668 Oslo

To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
We're seeking an engineer who loves getting close to the hardware to build the brains for our global sensor network.

 

Must haves

  • Proven experience in embedded systems development using C/C++.

  • Strong understanding of low-level hardware interfaces and communication protocols (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART).

  • Solid debugging skills for hardware and firmware issues, using tools like logic analyzers and oscilloscopes.

  • Foundational knowledge of electronics and the ability to read schematics.

  • Eligible to work in Norway (must hold relevant work authorization or citizenship).

  • For recent graduates: A relevant academic background (e.g., Cybernetics, Electronics, Computer Science) and a portfolio showcasing personal projects in firmware or embedded systems.

 

Nice to haves

  • A proactive mindset, comfortable taking ownership from concept to deployment.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment and embrace using modern tools, including AI, to enhance your workflow.

  • An innate curiosity for how things work and a passion for building robust, efficient systems.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work closely with hardware and cloud software teams.

  • You are motivated by seeing your work have a tangible, real-world impact.

 

About the job

Write the code that powers a smarter global supply chain.

We're expanding our firmware team and looking for a motivated Firmware Engineer. You will be instrumental in developing the core logic for our next-generation container sensors, which are cutting-edge IoT devices designed to track containers worldwide using cellular and satellite communication. These incredibly low-power devices operate for over 12 years on primary cell batteries, requiring no charging or service – making them truly unattended in the field. You'll be working in a fast-paced environment where you'll have significant ownership over your projects. This is a chance to build tangible products that have a real-world impact on global logistics.

  • Design, develop, and maintain firmware for our low-power, long-life embedded IoT devices.

  • Optimize firmware for ultra-low power consumption to meet our industry-leading battery life targets.

  • Collaborate directly with hardware engineers on board bring-up, validation, and debugging.

  • Develop and maintain robust test suites and automated testing infrastructure for firmware validation.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that span the hardware, firmware, and cloud interface.

 

What You'll Be Building

From Code to Container

As a Firmware Engineer at Balder, you're not just writing code; you're creating the intelligence that powers our global network of smart containers. You will be a key player in a small, agile team responsible for the entire firmware lifecycle, from initial concept and architecture to deployment and in-field updates. You will work on optimizing for our industry-leading battery life, developing robust communication protocols, and ensuring our sensors perform reliably in the harshest conditions. Your work will directly contribute to making global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable.

 

Our Engineering Culture

How We Build

We are building a team that is passionate about quality, innovation, and impact. Our culture is built on trust and a shared drive to create world-class technology.

🚀 High Ownership We believe in empowering our engineers. You'll own projects end-to-end, making key technical decisions that shape our products.

🤖 AI-Augmented Workflow We leverage cutting-edge AI tools to streamline development, debug faster, and focus on solving the most challenging problems.

🤝 Hardware & Software Synergy Our teams work in tight collaboration. You'll be side-by-side with hardware and cloud engineers, ensuring seamless integration.

🌍 Global Scale The firmware you write will be deployed on devices across the planet, providing critical data for global supply chains.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Balder is a Norwegian tech startup founded in 2025. We're on a mission to turn every container into a source of insight, providing real-time monitoring for more efficient global operations. We deliver an end-to-end solution for container asset-tracking, consisting of hardware, firmware, infrastructure and consumer applications that are designed and developed in-house.

title: Programatic specialist
description:
Programatic specialist

Are you a driven digital marketer with an eye for what's next? We're looking for a sharp, forward-thinking Programmatic Specialist to strengthen our team in Oslo. You'll take on a central role in shaping how we buy media on the open web, inside a team and an industry that never stand still.

We're after someone curious, proactive and structured who thrives when things move fast. You communicate well, work well with others, and have a genuine interest in programmatic advertising; experience with performance-driven campaigns is a bonus. You're not afraid to question how things have always been done, and you'd rather find a solution than dwell on the problem.


About SeenThis

The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent.

Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open. Our team of 130+ people works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York and Sydney.

We're expanding across all teams and looking for new colleagues who want to make a real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily. Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it and win together? Join SeenThis.


About the role

Campaign management & optimization

  • Manage your own client portfolio and provide strategic guidance along the way.

  • Set up, optimize and report on programmatic campaigns.

  • Evaluate programmatic platforms and spot new opportunities worth pursuing.

Collaboration & strategy

  • Present strategic recommendations to advertisers and clients.

  • Take part in pitches and other new, innovative projects.

  • Share what you know and help sharpen the team's skills in data and technology.


What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' experience with programmatic buying and solutions.

  • Experience with, or a solid understanding of, programmatic DSPs such as Amazon, Google DV360, Adform or The Trade Desk.

  • A commercial mindset that connects programmatic buying to what clients are actually trying to achieve.

  • Analytical skills, with the confidence to turn data into concrete action.

  • A solid understanding of digital buying across channels.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with web technologies (HTML/JavaScript).

  • Experience with performance-driven advertising.

  • Background in video advertising or familiarity with the open web ecosystem.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field.


Application

We review applications and interview on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Because of the high volume of applications we receive, we're not able to give personalized feedback before the interview stage. Thanks for understanding.

We run background checks on all SeenThis hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.

We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2017, Swedish tech company SeenThis has been evolving screen experiences for everyone, everywhere. With its groundbreaking adaptive streaming technology, SeenThis is transforming the distribution and climate impact of digital content. With billions of streams served for more than 1000 brands in over 40 countries, the company is on a journey to reshape the internet — for good. Working across eight offices globally, SeenThis employees are obsessed with creating a truly high-speed and energy efficient Internet.

title: Senior People Advisor
description:
At reMarkable, we build products designed to help people think better. Behind those products is an ambitious, international organization, and our People team plays an important role in helping the company, our leaders and our employees succeed.

We are looking for a Senior People Advisor to join our People team in Oslo. This is a broad People role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, building strong relationships, and turning organizational needs into practical action. You will work across the full employee lifecycle, act as a trusted advisor, and lead cross-functional projects that shape our employee experience.

About the role

As a Senior People Advisor, you will partner closely with leaders to understand their organisation, challenges, and priorities. You will provide advice and support on both strategic and operational People topics while helping leaders translate business needs into effective decisions.

As reMarkable continues to grow, an important part of our agenda is strengthening our organisation, leadership, and culture while maintaining the speed and ambition of a technology company. You will join a team where there is plenty to build, improve, and influence.


Your responsibilities will include

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and change.

  • Coaching managers on leadership, performance, feedback, and employee development.

  • Supporting employee relations matters in accordance with Norwegian employment legislation and internal policies.

  • Supporting and driving People processes across the employee lifecycle, using data and insights to address challenges.

  • Leading cross-functional People projects from scoping through stakeholder alignment, implementation, and follow-up.


We are looking for the following experience

  • Solid experience from an HR Business Partner or People Advisor role, including handling organisational change.

  • Experience partnering directly with managers and senior leaders.

  • Good understanding of Norwegian employment legislation.

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects or People processes.

  • Strong communication skills in English (Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage).

Experience from technology, product or another fast-moving international environment is valuable, but not essential.

In addition, we believe that you are comfortable working independently with leaders and thrive in an environment where priorities can change and challenges do not come with predefined solutions. We don't expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to be curious, willing to challenge assumptions, comfortable learning as you go, and motivated by making both people and organizations better.


Why we enjoy working here

  • The opportunity to join a People team with broad mandate, being part of shaping our next chapter.

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.


If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves! As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Programatic specialist
description:
Programatic specialist

Are you a driven digital marketer with an eye for what's next? We're looking for a sharp, forward-thinking Programmatic Specialist to strengthen our team in Oslo. You'll take on a central role in shaping how we buy media on the open web, inside a team and an industry that never stand still.

We're after someone curious, proactive and structured who thrives when things move fast. You communicate well, work well with others, and have a genuine interest in programmatic advertising; experience with performance-driven campaigns is a bonus. You're not afraid to question how things have always been done, and you'd rather find a solution than dwell on the problem.


About SeenThis

The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent.

Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open. Our team of 130+ people works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York and Sydney.

We're expanding across all teams and looking for new colleagues who want to make a real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily. Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it and win together? Join SeenThis.


About the role

Campaign management & optimization

  • Manage your own client portfolio and provide strategic guidance along the way.

  • Set up, optimize and report on programmatic campaigns.

  • Evaluate programmatic platforms and spot new opportunities worth pursuing.

Collaboration & strategy

  • Present strategic recommendations to advertisers and clients.

  • Take part in pitches and other new, innovative projects.

  • Share what you know and help sharpen the team's skills in data and technology.


What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' experience with programmatic buying and solutions.

  • Experience with, or a solid understanding of, programmatic DSPs such as Amazon, Google DV360, Adform or The Trade Desk.

  • A commercial mindset that connects programmatic buying to what clients are actually trying to achieve.

  • Analytical skills, with the confidence to turn data into concrete action.

  • A solid understanding of digital buying across channels.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with web technologies (HTML/JavaScript).

  • Experience with performance-driven advertising.

  • Background in video advertising or familiarity with the open web ecosystem.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field.


Application

We review applications and interview on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Because of the high volume of applications we receive, we're not able to give personalized feedback before the interview stage. Thanks for understanding.

We run background checks on all SeenThis hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.

We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Since 2017, Swedish tech company SeenThis has been evolving screen experiences for everyone, everywhere. With its groundbreaking adaptive streaming technology, SeenThis is transforming the distribution and climate impact of digital content. With billions of streams served for more than 1000 brands in over 40 countries, the company is on a journey to reshape the internet — for good. Working across eight offices globally, SeenThis employees are obsessed with creating a truly high-speed and energy efficient Internet.

title: Senior People Advisor
description:
At reMarkable, we build products designed to help people think better. Behind those products is an ambitious, international organization, and our People team plays an important role in helping the company, our leaders and our employees succeed.

We are looking for a Senior People Advisor to join our People team in Oslo. This is a broad People role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, building strong relationships, and turning organizational needs into practical action. You will work across the full employee lifecycle, act as a trusted advisor, and lead cross-functional projects that shape our employee experience.

About the role

As a Senior People Advisor, you will partner closely with leaders to understand their organisation, challenges, and priorities. You will provide advice and support on both strategic and operational People topics while helping leaders translate business needs into effective decisions.

As reMarkable continues to grow, an important part of our agenda is strengthening our organisation, leadership, and culture while maintaining the speed and ambition of a technology company. You will join a team where there is plenty to build, improve, and influence.


Your responsibilities will include

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and change.

  • Coaching managers on leadership, performance, feedback, and employee development.

  • Supporting employee relations matters in accordance with Norwegian employment legislation and internal policies.

  • Supporting and driving People processes across the employee lifecycle, using data and insights to address challenges.

  • Leading cross-functional People projects from scoping through stakeholder alignment, implementation, and follow-up.


We are looking for the following experience

  • Solid experience from an HR Business Partner or People Advisor role, including handling organisational change.

  • Experience partnering directly with managers and senior leaders.

  • Good understanding of Norwegian employment legislation.

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects or People processes.

  • Strong communication skills in English (Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage).

Experience from technology, product or another fast-moving international environment is valuable, but not essential.

In addition, we believe that you are comfortable working independently with leaders and thrive in an environment where priorities can change and challenges do not come with predefined solutions. We don't expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to be curious, willing to challenge assumptions, comfortable learning as you go, and motivated by making both people and organizations better.


Why we enjoy working here

  • The opportunity to join a People team with broad mandate, being part of shaping our next chapter.

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.


If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves! As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Bus Drivers / Bus Sjåfør
description:
Enter Tromsø is seeking reliable and safety-focused Bus Drivers to join our transportation team in Tromsø. The successful candidate will be responsible for transporting passengers safely and efficiently along assigned routes while providing excellent customer service. The position requires compliance with Norwegian transport regulations and a strong commitment to passenger safety.

Temporary position: The position is temporary and will run until 31 March 2027.
Start date: As soon as possible.


Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate a passenger bus along scheduled routes.

  • Ensure passenger safety during boarding, travel, and disembarking.

  • Perform pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections.

  • Follow all traffic laws and company safety procedures.

  • Provide friendly and professional customer service to passengers.

  • Maintain accurate logs and report any incidents or maintenance issues.

  • Assist passengers with accessibility needs when required.

Required Qualifications

Applicants must meet the legal requirements for operating a bus in Norway:

  • Valid Category D Driver's License (Bus License) issued in Norway or recognized within the EEA.

  • Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC / Yrkessjåførkompetanse -- YSK) for passenger transport.

  • Valid Driver Qualification Card (YSK card).

  • Clean driving record and ability to pass a background check.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in Norwegian or English.

  • Minimum age requirements as required for professional bus drivers in Norway.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience operating buses or heavy vehicles.

  • Good knowledge of local routes in Tromsø and surrounding areas.

  • Customer service experience.

  • Basic mechanical awareness for vehicle inspections.

Working Conditions

  • Shift work including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidaysas our company operates every day during the peak winter season (1 October -- 31 March).

  • Shifts include bus transfers between Tromsø & Malangen Resort, as well as Northern lights trips

title: Hands-On Facility Manager for a Growing Property Portfolio
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Facility Manager to ensure smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio. You will coordinate staff, linen logistics, maintenance, and property quality.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications:

  • Experience from cleaning, property management, hospitality, or similar operational work is an advantage

  • Structured, reliable, and comfortable taking responsibility

  • Hands-on and solution-oriented, with an eye for quality and detail

  • Comfortable coordinating people, schedules, and day-to-day operations

  • Comfortable using digital tools and documentation

  • Flexible and available during the day, including weekends when needed

  • Able to communicate well in Norwegian or English

  • A valid driver's licence

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Facility Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning staff schedules, managing labour-hour budgets, and following up on actual hours worked.

  • Managing linen logistics, including distribution, stock levels, ordering, returns, and collection.

  • Identifying and following up on property issues, defects, and maintenance needs, including coordinating repairs, contractors, and suppliers.

  • Ensuring high cleaning standards through training, quality control, and regular inspections of the cleaning team.

  • Carrying out regular property inspections, including checks of appliances, lighting, heaters, smoke detectors, and other equipment.

  • Documenting and managing guest-related damages and compensation claims, including photos, estimates, invoices, and supporting documentation for Airbnb, Booking.com, insurance providers, or property owners.

  • Taking an active part in daily cleaning operations to lead by example and maintain a strong understanding of day-to-day operations.

  • A key operational role with responsibility and freedom to make decisions

  • Competitive pay

  • Independent and varied work across our growing property portfolio

Tromsø Fremleie AS is a local and growing property management company in Tromsø. We provide professional property operations and accommodation services on behalf of property owners, with a strong focus on quality, efficient operations, and well-maintained homes.

title: 🌌 Join the Aurora Wonderland Team – Winter Season 2026–2027 🌌
description:
We're looking for one new Team Member to complete our team for the upcoming winter season. If you enjoy Arctic nature, tourism, varied workdays, and the idea of working at a small basecamp surrounded by the beautiful Lyngen Alps, this might be the job for you.

💼 What You'll Do

As a Basecamp Team Member, you'll have varied workdays and take part in many different areas of our daily operations. We offer outdoor activities, serve meals, and provide overnight accommodation, so your tasks may range from housekeeping in our Crystal Lavvos to guiding snowshoe walks, preparing meals, and helping guests get ready for activities.

No two days are quite the same, and there is always something happening at the basecamp.

Tasks may include:

  • Hosting and assisting guests

  • Preparing and serving simple meals

  • Cleaning and housekeeping

  • Assisting with snowmobile tours

  • Guiding snowshoe walks

  • Driving and transporting guests

  • Preparing equipment and organizing activities

  • Snow clearing and other outdoor work

  • General practical and logistical tasks around the basecamp

✅ What We're Looking For

We are looking for an active, positive, and flexible person who enjoys the Arctic outdoors and likes a varied, hands-on workday.

You should enjoy being part of a small, close-knit team and working with international guests. One day you might guide a snowshoe walk; the next you could prepare lunch, clean a Crystal Lavvo, help guests, or get equipment ready for an activity.

This role suits someone who genuinely enjoys variety, teamwork, guest interaction, practical work, and Arctic life.

📌 Requirements

  • Fluent and comfortable communicating in English

  • Enjoys working with people and providing good guest service

  • Comfortable working indoors and outdoors in cold and snowy conditions

  • Comfortable with cleaning, housekeeping, laundry, and kitchen duties

  • Physically fit and ready for active workdays

  • Flexible and able to adapt when plans or tasks change

  • Able to follow routines, instructions, and safety procedures

  • Positive attitude and comfortable working as part of a small team

  • Willing to work during Christmas, New Year, and the busy winter season

  • Happy to help wherever needed rather than having one fixed role

  • Interested in Arctic nature and life in Northern Norway

🌟 Bonus Skills -- Nice to Have, Not Required

Experience in any of the following is a plus:

  • Tourism, hospitality, or customer service

  • Cooking or kitchen work

  • Cleaning and housekeeping

  • Guiding or outdoor tourism

  • Snowshoeing, hiking, cross-country skiing, or snowmobiling

  • Photography

  • Valid Class B driver's license

  • Comfortable driving in winter conditions

  • Additional languages such as Spanish, French, Italian, German, or Mandarin

🏔️ What We Offer

  • A unique, hands-on experience working in Arctic tourism

  • A varied role with different tasks throughout the season

  • Training for the different tasks and activities at the basecamp

  • The opportunity to work with guests from around the world

  • A small and friendly team environment

  • Work surrounded by the Lyngen Alps, fjords, snow, and Northern Lights

  • Competitive salary

  • On-site accommodation available

📌 Open Position

Basecamp Team Member -- 1 position

We are looking for one person to complete our winter team , starting around December or January and working until the end of March.

💌 Interested?

Send us your CV and a few words about yourself . We would especially love to receive a short 1--2 minute video introducing yourself, telling us a little about who you are and why you would like to join our team.

If it sounds like a good match, we'll give you a call!

Located in Nord-Lenangen, Lyngen , surrounded by fjords and the beautiful Lyngen Alps, our basecamp offers a range of Arctic experiences. Guests can enjoy snowmobile tours, guided snowshoe walks, and overnight stays in our Crystal Lavvos.

title: Territory Manager , Peripheral Vascular Health
description:
Medtronic’s Peripheral Vascular Health team supports vascular disease treatment through endovascular and minimally invasive therapies, advancing clinical education, therapy adoption, and patient access across Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

This field-based commercial role is responsible for developing the PVH business within an assigned territory in Norway. The position requires regular customer visits, attendance at procedures, participation in educational activities, and collaboration with Nordic and cross-functional teams. Frequent travel throughout Norway and occasional travel within the Nordic region are required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and some sales experience within medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, or a comparable commercial environment.

  • Experience managing customer accounts and delivering against defined sales or business objectives.

  • Fluency in Norwegian and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel regularly throughout Norway and occasionally within the Nordic region.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the medical device industry, particularly in peripheral vascular, interventional radiology, vascular surgery, embolization, or venous therapies.

  • Knowledge of the Norwegian healthcare system, hospital purchasing processes, and stakeholder landscape.

  • Experience supporting public procurement, tender submissions, and contracting activities.

  • Experience providing clinical, technical, or procedural support for complex medical technologies.

  • Experience engaging with healthcare professionals in hospital-based environments.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Territory Manager, Peripheral Vascular Health, you will be responsible for driving business growth, managing customer relationships, and supporting the adoption of Medtronic vascular therapies across your territory. You will work closely with healthcare professionals and internal partners to execute territory plans, identify new opportunities, and deliver commercial and clinical support to customers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned with business objectives to drive market growth and achieve sales targets.

  • Identify, engage, and build relationships with key stakeholders, including physicians, nurses, procurement teams, administrators, and key opinion leaders.

  • Grow existing accounts and develop new business opportunities through effective account management and territory planning.

  • Deliver product presentations, clinical education, and technical support to support therapy adoption and customer success.

  • Support procedures and provide product expertise to healthcare professionals when required.

  • Lead commercial discussions and collaborate on pricing, contracting, and public tender activities.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, customer activity records, and opportunity pipelines using company systems.

  • Partner with Nordic colleagues and cross-functional teams to support customer needs, educational activities, and business initiatives.

Vi tilbyr

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Pay range / Rango salarial / Intervalo salarial /Fascia retributiva / Tranche de salaire / Gehaltsband / Salaribereik: Norway: 589,600.00 NOK - 884,400.00 NOK |

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first --- developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

title: Faglært kokk -  Scandic Nidelven
description:
Vi ser etter deg som er genuint interessert i god mat, lokal kultur og har lyst til å være med på å forme hotellets matfremtid.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver som kokk:

  • tilrettelegge og lage mat av høy kvalitet i samsvar med våre ulike matkonsepter
  • følge prosedyrer i henhold til IK-mat, renhold og sikkerhet
  • bidra til at avdelingen når forventninger til gjestetilfredshet, kvalitet og lønnsomhet
  • følge rutiner for økologiske- og kravmerkede produkter og kildesortering, samt bidra til å redusere matsvinn
  • bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø og samarbeid med kollegaer i kjøkkenet og andre avdelinger

Kvalifikasjoner og utdanning:

  • fagbrev som kokk er en betingelse
  • kan vise til gode resultater fra lignende stilling
  • snakker du ett av våre skandinaviske språk er det en stor fordel, men dersom dine engelskkunnskaper er gode og du er en fremragende kokk er det aller viktigst for oss

Personlige egenskaper:

  • leken, kreativ og kvalitetsbevisst - du vil få stor grad av frihet til å imponere våre gjester hver eneste dag
  • godt humør, liker å by på deg selv og ikke er redd for å servere dine egne retter til gjestene når det er mulig ser vi som et stort fortrinn

Som kokk ved rapporterer du til kjøkkensjef, du vil jobbe etter vaktliste og må påregne arbeid på kvelder og i helger.

Vi imøteser din søknad så snart som mulig, og vil behandle alle søknader fortløpende.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, Scandic eller ønsker å vite mer om Scandic Nidelven er du velkommen til å kontakte vår kjøkkensjef.

Tiltredelse i stillingen er så snart som mulig, og vil vare til 20. desember 2026. Mulighet for videre ansettelse.

Vi verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen vår og er interessert i å lære mer om dine behov og eventuelle tilrettelegginger som kan støtte deg i å lykkes i denne rollen. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av funksjonsnivå eller bakgrunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alt starter med deg. Å jobbe på et av våre hoteller betyr å være en del av et team der omtanke, samarbeid og små øyeblikk i hverdagen gjør en forskjell. Du er med på å skape den varme, hjemmekoselig følelsen som kjennetegner Scandic – ved å være til stede, her og nå, og la detaljene telle.

Noen dager går fort, andre er mer forutsigbare – ingen dager er helt like. Men det som alltid består, er lagånden. Dere stiller opp for hverandre, løser ting når de oppstår og er stolte av å levere kvalitet – selv når tempoet er høyt. Og når dere gjør det, vil gjestene ikke bare nyte oppholdet – de får lyst til å komme tilbake.

Slik jobber vi i Scandic

Vi er på vårt beste når vi jobber sammen – på tvers av roller, hoteller og team – og fokuserer på det som virkelig gjør en forskjell i hverdagen. Våre verdier veileder oss i hvordan vi møter hverandre og hvordan vi leverer: Be Pro, Be Bold, Be Caring og Be You.

Hvis du mener at ekte gjestfrihet skapes gjennom samarbeid, jevn kvalitet og små øyeblikk gjort godt, vil du føle deg hjemme hos oss.

title: Technical Sales Manager Baltikum & Polen (m/w/d) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
description:
„Ventiltechnik verbindet Märkte weltweit“

Technical Sales Manager Baltikum & Polen (m/w/d) in Warszawa

Als spezialisierte Personalvermittlung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau begleiten wir aktuell die Besetzung einer internationalen Vertriebsposition im Bereich technische Industrieprodukte. Für unseren Kunden suchen wir einen Business Developer (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Baltikum, Polen und Ukraine. Das Unternehmen entwickelt und vertreibt hochwertige Sicherheitsarmaturen für unterschiedlichste industrielle Anwendungen weltweit. Die Position wird durch uns im Rahmen einer Direktanstellung beim Kunden besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie betreuen und entwickeln Kundenbeziehungen in den Zielmärkten Baltikum, Polen und Ukraine eigenverantwortlich weiter.

Sie identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und gewinnen aktiv Neukunden im industriellen Umfeld.

Sie beraten Kunden technisch zu Sicherheitsarmaturen und individuellen Anwendungslösungen.

Sie erstellen Angebote, verfolgen Projekte nach und pflegen Kunden- sowie Marktdaten strukturiert.

Sie repräsentieren das Unternehmen auf Fachmessen, Kundenterminen und Produktpräsentationen.

Sie analysieren Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus Vertriebsmaßnahmen ab.

Ihr Profil:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, idealerweise im Maschinenbau, der Verfahrenstechnik oder im Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen.
- Sie bringen Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb oder Business Development mit – idealerweise im Anlagenbau oder der Ventiltechnik.
- Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch oder Englisch sowie mindestens einer osteuropäischen Sprache.
- Sie überzeugen durch Kundenorientierung, Eigeninitiative und Verhandlungsgeschick.
- Sie arbeiten strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und fühlen sich in internationalen Märkten wohl.

Was unser Kunde bietet:

- Internationale Vertriebsaufgabe mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum.
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem familiengeführten Industrieunternehmen mit globaler Präsenz.
- Moderne Arbeitsstrukturen mit offener Kommunikation und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
- Vielseitige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld.
- Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit wertschätzendem Betriebsklima.

Was unser Kunde bietet:
