title: Creative Director
description:
Agency-Based | Outdoor, Lifestyle & Active IndustriesPosition Overview

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Creative Director to lead the creative vision and execution of campaigns, content, and brand experiences for clients across the outdoor, lifestyle, wellness, fitness, sport, travel, and active industries.

This agency-based role will work across multiple client accounts, translating business objectives, audience insights, and brand positioning into compelling creative strategies and culturally relevant content. The Creative Director will lead projects from initial concept through production, delivery, and rollout, ensuring that every asset is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, operationally sound, and aligned with each client’s brand standards.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary creative leader and a strong operator—someone who can inspire teams, present and defend ideas, build trusted client relationships, and confidently manage the details required to deliver high-quality work across multiple channels and timelines.

Creative Leadership and Vision

Lead the conceptual, strategic, and visual direction of seasonal campaigns, evergreen content programs, product launches, brand initiatives, and ongoing client communications.

Establish and maintain a distinctive, consistent, and relevant visual identity for each client.

Influence the look, feel, tone, and overall creative expression of brand assets across regional, national, and global markets.

Translate strategic insights, marketing objectives, audience needs, and business goals into clear creative strategies and engaging content platforms.

Develop creative approaches that inspire, move, and connect with end users while authentically expressing each brand’s purpose, values, and point of view.

Set creative standards and provide direction across photography, video, graphic design, digital artwork, motion design, typography, copy integration, and branded experiences.

Stay current on emerging trends in culture, design, digital marketing, social media, technology, production, and the outdoor, lifestyle, and active industries.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen client brands while maintaining consistency with established brand guidelines.

Concept Development:

Generate original ideas in response to creative briefs, strategic assignments, campaign objectives, and client needs.

Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign platforms, content series, product stories, and integrated brand experiences.

Create and oversee concept boards, mood boards, visual references, style guides, treatments, sketches, mockups, storyboards, and presentation materials.

Clearly communicate creative concepts, strategic rationale, intended audience impact, and production approach to clients and internal stakeholders.

Present, sell, and defend creative ideas with confidence, clarity, and sound strategic reasoning.

Develop custom content ideas and creative approaches for retail, ecommerce, wholesale, merchandising, sales, social, editorial, digital, and experiential channels.

Ensure creative ideas are scalable and adaptable across formats, markets, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

Lead creative projects from concept development through pre-production, production, post-production, final delivery, and rollout.

Plan, strategize, and execute lifestyle and product photography and videography shoots.

Drive and direct global and regional campaign photo and video shoots, ensuring that the creative vision is consistently realized on set and through post-production.

Develop creative treatments, shot lists, storyboards, casting direction, location recommendations, styling direction, production schedules, and visual references.

Collaborate closely with photographers, directors, videographers, producers, stylists, set designers, editors, animators, retouchers, developers, and other production specialists.

Provide creative direction during casting, location scouting, pre-production meetings, shoots, editing sessions, color grading, retouching, sound design, animation, and final delivery.

Balance creative ambition with budget, schedule, logistics, production realities, client needs, and usage requirements.

Review and approve work at all stages to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the approved creative direction.

Experience leading both in-house and external creative, production, and freelance teams.

As necessary, must be proficient shooting still imagery to lead or supplement campaigns, provide BTS imagery or conceptual imagery.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead and manage in-house, freelance, outsourced, and partner creative teams across multiple client accounts.

Direct photographers, videographers, production teams, stylists, designers, developers, editors, agencies, and other external specialists.

Build and facilitate a highly motivated, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable creative environment.

Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, workflows, feedback processes, and quality standards for project teams.

Mentor and develop creative talent, supporting professional growth and encouraging new perspectives.

Assemble the right creative and production resources for each project based on scope, budget, timeline, and required expertise.

Manage contract and freelance production staff, including sourcing, briefing, scheduling, negotiating, onboarding, and evaluating external partners.

Foster strong relationships across creative, strategy, account management, production, marketing, digital, sales, merchandising, retail, and leadership teams.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure creative work is strategically aligned and operationally effective.

    Good reading and writing in both Swedish and English
    Preferred experience in pharma industry or other international environment

title: International Trainee  Fuel Engineer at Forsmark
description:
Job Description

Shape the future of energy.  

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.  

What you will experience  

Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.

Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.

Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

Your role as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

The Fuel Engineering team provides technical expertise within nuclear fuel, control rods and safeguards. The team leads and supports projects related to the reactor core and fuel, including core modifications, fuel repairs, procurement of control rods and nuclear fuel, fuel and control rod licensing activities, safeguards and planning of fuel transport. The work combines technical support, project coordination and long-term development of fuel-related activities at Forsmark Nuclear Power Plant.

As a trainee, you will support both ongoing operational activities and development initiatives. Your responsibilities may include:

Supporting activities related to nuclear fuel

Participating in inspections of nuclear fuel and control rods

Reviewing technical reports, analyses and documentation

Supporting technical investigations and evaluations

Analyzing operational and inspection data

Contributing to development improvement initiatives

Collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders to solve technical challenges

The work is varied and combines technical analysis with practical activities. You may spend one day reviewing technical reports and inspection results, and another day supporting activities in the reactor hall during planned outage periods.

You will work closely with experienced team members and gain exposure to many different parts of the business. The role is particularly suitable for someone who wants to build long-term expertise within the nuclear fuel area and develop as a technical specialist over time.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably within Energy Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline

Excellent written and oral communication skills in Swedish and English

An interest in nuclear technology, energy systems and industrial operations

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

Experience of programming, scripting or data analysis is considered an advantage

Knowledge of MATLAB or similar tools is considered an advantage

Experience from technical projects, laboratory work or industrial environments is considered an advantage

An interest in process improvement and digitalization is considered an advantage

You should also recognize yourself in the following:

You are curious and eager to learn within a specialist field

You take responsibility and approach your work in a structured way

You work well both independently and together with colleagues and stakeholders

You are motivated by solving technical challenges and contributing to shared goals  

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027

Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles

Be fluent in English

Be available for the full-time programme from its start date

Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements

Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.

Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:  

You will be working in the Fuel Engineering team and located in Forsmark, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer  

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers. You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission. Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.

In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization. You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

﻿

Your future challenge

This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager. This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

﻿

Tasks

• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.

• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.

• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.

• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.

• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.

• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

﻿

Required skills

﻿

• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.

• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.

• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).

• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

﻿

This is a full-time consultant position in Jönköping through Incluso. Start is November 1st, 13 months limited contract to begin with - possibility of extension after that. This role is 100% onsite in Jönköping.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

title: Technical Support Engineer- EV charging & Battery Storage
description:
The role combines pre-sales technical support, solution design, customer training, commissioning, and after-sales support. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, production, installers, and other partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

· Provide pre-sales technical consultation and solution design for EV charging, BESS, and PV projects.

· Prepare technical solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions, including:

o System sizing and architecture

o Product selection and configuration

o EV charger, BESS, and PV integration

o Economic analysis to identify cost-effective system configurations

· Support the sales team with technical clarification, project discussions, and the preparation of technical proposals.

· Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations independently.

· Perform or support on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and configuration of EV chargers and BESS systems.

· Provide after-sales technical support, including fault analysis, troubleshooting, and coordination with customers, installers, and internal engineering teams.

· Work closely with R&D and product teams to communicate field feedback and support technical issue resolution and product improvement.

· Travel mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to other Nordic and European markets as required for commissioning, troubleshooting, training, customer visits, and other technical support activities.

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation, or another relevant technical field.

· Good understanding of industrial low-voltage (LV) electrical systems, particularly 400 V three-phase systems commonly used in commercial and industrial applications.

· Familiarity with electrical components and equipment such as power cables, circuit breakers, protection devices, energy meters, current transformers (CTs), controllers, switches, relays, and electrical distribution equipment.

· Ability to understand basic cable sizing, electrical connections, power distribution, protection concepts, and equipment interfaces.

· Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, technical documentation, and system diagrams.

· Comfortable working hands-on with electrical and control equipment during testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.

· Able to independently perform basic system checks, equipment configuration, commissioning preparation, and fault diagnosis within the scope of the role.

· Strong interest in renewable energy, energy storage, EV charging, smart energy management, and electrification technologies.

· Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales teams, engineers, customers, installers, and other partners.

· Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are considered strong advantages:

· Previous experience in EV charging infrastructure, BESS, power systems, renewable energy, PV, EMS, or related technologies.

· Experience working with 400 V LV distribution systems, switchboards, electrical cabinets, meters, controllers, and related field equipment.

· Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, or technical support of electrical or power electronic equipment.

· Practical understanding of power cables, cable selection, CTs, energy meters, protection devices, and electrical measurement equipment.

· Experience using common electrical measurement and diagnostic tools during commissioning and troubleshooting.

· Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as Modbus TCP/RTU, OCPP, Ethernet, RS485, or similar industrial communication systems.

· Basic understanding of industrial networking, IP configuration, and communication between chargers, BESS, meters, controllers, and EMS systems is an advantage.

· Swedish or European electrical qualification/certificate, or relevant practical experience in electrical installation and commissioning.

Personal Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

· Technically curious and willing to continuously learn new products and technologies.

· Genuinely interested in the rapidly developing EV charging, energy storage, and renewable energy industries.

· Customer-oriented and comfortable communicating technical topics with different stakeholders.

· Hands-on and willing to participate in field testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning.

· Structured, responsible, and capable of managing multiple technical tasks or projects in parallel.

· Flexible and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-growing technical environment.

title: Site Manager, Sweden-based projects, Nordec
description:
Nordec is one of the leading providers of steel structures and façade solutions in Northern Europe. We design, manufacture and install steel structures for demanding construction projects, ranging from industrial facilities and logistics centres to large-scale data centres and other landmark developments.

Barona is recruiting Site Managers on behalf of Nordec. The selected candidates will be employed directly by Nordec in a permanent position.

As Nordec continues to strengthen its presence in Sweden and across Northern Europe, we are looking for experienced Site Managers to lead installation works on demanding construction projects.

This is an opportunity for an experienced site professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with people leadership, customer collaboration and hands-on project execution. In this role, you will be at the heart of project delivery, ensuring that installation activities are completed safely, efficiently and according to agreed quality and schedule targets.

As a Site Manager, you will act as one of Nordec's key representatives on site. You will lead installation teams and subcontractors, coordinate daily site operations and work closely with customers, project management and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

    Leading and coordinating on-site installation activities

    Managing site teams and subcontractors

    Ensuring quality, safety, schedule, cost control and productivity targets are achieved

    Acting as the main on-site contact towards customers and stakeholders

    Monitoring project progress and reporting to the Project Manager

    Resolving operational challenges and supporting efficient project execution

The role requires sound technical understanding, strong leadership capabilities and the ability to maintain productive relationships with customers, partners and site personnel in a dynamic project environment.

What we are looking for

We are interested in professionals who have gained substantial experience in site management, construction management or related leadership roles within construction and industrial projects.

To succeed in the role, you have:

    Several years of experience in site management, project management or a comparable leadership position

    Proven ability to lead teams and coordinate multiple stakeholders in demanding project environments

    Strong understanding of construction processes, site operations and safety requirements

    Experience from large industrial projects, data centres or other technically demanding construction projects is considered an advantage

    Experience of cost control and budgeting

    Fluent English language skills, Swedish is considered an advantage

    A structured, proactive and solution-oriented way of working

    Willingness to travel according to project requirements

Why join Nordec?

Nordec offers the opportunity to work on some of the most technically demanding construction projects in Northern Europe. The company is involved in projects that combine engineering expertise, high-quality execution and international collaboration.

As a Site Manager, you will have a central role in project delivery and significant responsibility for driving successful outcomes on site. You will work alongside experienced professionals in an international environment where expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving are highly valued.

The role offers long-term career opportunities within a growing organisation operating across several European markets and project sectors.

Applications will be reviewed during the recruitment process, and positions will be filled once suitable candidates have been identified.

This recruitment is conducted in cooperation with Barona. For further information regarding the position and the recruitment process, please contact Johnny Seijsing at Barona Sweden. Please note that, due to information security and GDPR requirements, we cannot accept applications by email or WhatsApp.

title: Produktionsutvecklare Logistik, Epiroc i Kalmar
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Vill du arbeta nära produktionen och vara med och utveckla framtidens logistiklösningar? Epiroc i Kalmar söker nu en produktionsutvecklare inom logistik som vill bidra till vår fortsatta tillväxtresa. Här får du en viktig roll i att skapa stabila, effektiva och framtidssäkra logistikprocesser – med verklig påverkan på vår verksamhet.

I Kalmar tillverkar vi världsledande hydrauliska produkter för gruv- och anläggningsindustrin. Just nu befinner vi oss i en spännande utvecklingsfas där vi investerar i nya flöden, ökad automation och moderna arbetssätt i både produktion och logistik. Följ med när vi accelererar transformationen!

Bli en del av vårt team Du blir en del av ett engagerat team inom produktionsutveckling, där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och ett öppet klimat står i centrum. Här kombineras styrkan från en global koncern med flexibiliteten i en lokal organisation, vilket ger både stabilitet och möjligheter att påverka på riktigt.

I rollen arbetar du nära flera funktioner, såsom produktion, underhåll, supply chain, kvalitet och inköp, och rapporterar till chef för produktionsutveckling. Beslutsvägarna är korta och du har goda möjligheter att utvecklas, driva förändring och bidra till förbättrade logistikflöden och automationslösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta del av dina perspektiv och idéer!

Ditt uppdrag Som produktionsutvecklare inom logistik driver du förbättringar och förändringar i våra materialflöden och processer, kopplat till både nya produkter och nya arbetssätt. Ett särskilt fokus i rollen är utvecklingen av vårt höglager, där du är delaktig i införandet av automatiserade lösningar och nya flödesupplägg.

I rollen ingår att:•    utveckla och effektivisera lager- och logistikflöden genom hela produktionen•    vara Business Key User (BKU) för skeppning, lager, FactoryTrack och Fleet Manager•    driva och delta i projekt kopplade till automation och ny teknik inom logistik•    leda förstudier samt planera och genomföra förändringar i våra arbetssätt•    samarbeta med leverantörer kring tekniska lösningar och förbättringar

Rollen innebär en kombination av logistikförståelse och tekniskt intresse, där du bidrar till att utveckla både flöden och automationslösningar.

Placering och resorTjänsten är placerad i Kalmar. Enstaka resor kan förekomma.

Ansökan och kontaktI den här rekryteringsprocessen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-04.

För frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen eller ansökan vänligen kontakta: Maria Tedsjö, Rekryteringsspecialist, maria.tedsjo@external.epiroc.com.För frågor om tjänsten vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Fredrik Hägglund, Production Development Manager, fredrik.hagglund@epiroc.com

Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:



•    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.

Profile description:

Din profilVi söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill vara med och utveckla både dig själv och vår verksamhet. Du har ett intresse för teknik och en förståelse för hur automation, system och logistikflöden hänger ihop.



Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera analys med praktiskt förbättringsarbete. Kanske har du tidigare arbetat i en produktions- eller logistikmiljö där du varit med och utvecklat arbetssätt, drivit förändringar eller deltagit i projekt. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt, gillar att lösa problem och har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika funktioner.



För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:•    högskoleutbildning inom logistik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande•    erfarenhet av arbete inom logistik, produktion eller projektledning•    god vana av att arbeta i system, exempelvis Excel•    goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift



Har du erfarenhet av Lean-arbete eller automatiserade logistiklösningar ser vi det som meriterande.

title: Research Coordinator
description:
Are you interested in working in an inspiring environment where you can support research and internationalisation? The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) Grants Office is looking for an experienced, skilled, and passionate Research Coordinator who is proactive, well-versed in external funding, and motivated to make a meaningful difference for researchers across the university.

The SLU Grants Office is a unit within the Division of Planning and Research Support. We provide expertise, support, advice, and information on external research funding to researchers, administrators, and university leadership. Our friendly, helpful, and professional team has a wide range of experience and expertise, enabling us to provide strategic and operational support both pre- and post-award. Our work focuses on proposal-writing advice and constructive feedback, budgeting, administration, and project management. We also provide information and capacity-building initiatives. We are currently based at SLU’s main campuses – Alnarp, Ultuna, and Umeå – but we all work to support the entire university.

Read more about the Grants Office at https://internt.slu.se/grantsoffice/.

Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at SLU at https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/.

Duties:

As our new Research Coordinator, your primary role will be to work with SLU researchers who are leading applications for collaborative grants such as Horizon Europe Pillar II, MSCA Doctoral Networks, and European Partnerships, with flexibility to support other initiatives as needed. You will offer targeted advice and guidance to SLU coordinators during the pre-award phase, assisting with developing suitable concepts, reviewing proposal texts, and recommending improvements. Additionally, you will provide broader support across SLU through outreach, capacity-building and communication efforts.

More specifically, together with colleagues, you will:

    Support researchers applying for external funding, primarily by providing constructive feedback on proposal drafts and helping them craft a clear, persuasive narrative aligned with the scope of the call.
    Disseminate information about future funding opportunities, proactively identify prospective applicants, and encourage them to apply.
    Design and deliver seminars and workshops focused on funders, funding opportunities and proposal writing, and contribute to events co-organised with other units at SLU.

title: Health & Safety Engineer
description:
Job Scope

High level purpose of function.

Supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's health and safety management system.

Ensures compliance with applicable work environment legislation, regulations, and company requirements. Identifies, assesses, and supports the control of occupational risks through risk assessments, exposure monitoring, inspections, and incident investigations.

Supports managers and operational teams in the daily work environment and safety activities, including risk assessments, investigations, and follow-up of incidents, near misses, and risk observations.

Promotes a proactive safety culture and contributes to continuous improvement of health and safety performance.

Key Responsibilities

    Collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders across the organization to lead, coordinate, and advance systematic health and safety management and the development of a strong safety culture.
    Participates in the work of building up a Health & Safety management system in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001 and Lyten's internal standards.
    Carry out training in health and safety.
    Compile and follow up KPI´s and report to management and other relevant parties.
    Support the organization in connection with risk assessments and other risk reviews.
    If necessary, support with investigations of incidents and accidents, with the aim of finding root causes and proposing measures to prevent it from happening again.
    Carry out investigations regarding physical work environment aspects such as exposure to chemical substances, noise, and ergonomic factors.
    Support the organization with expertise within health and safety.
    Inform, train, and coach leaders and employees in health and safety.
    Monitor and interpret changes in regulations.
    Manage or perform occupational exposure measurement.
    Manage and be superuser for existing systems regarding health and safety (TIA).
    Provide technical solutions for change management and new projects within health and safety.
    Lead or participate in health and safety related committees.
    Contacts with authorities.

Accountability/Authorization

    Budget responsibility: No
    Direct reports: No
    Manager work environment responsibility: No
    All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role.

    Degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, work environment engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent qualifications demonstrated through education and professional experience.
    5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator.
    Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes.
    Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
    Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
    Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus.
    Expertise in specific areas within health and safety, for example ergonomics, ATEX, or chemicals is a plus.

Specific skills

    Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
    Highly organized and result driven.
    Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
    Has a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial spirit.

title: Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Improve production economics through operational financial analysis



Would you like to support investment and operational decisions through reliable financial analysis? As Finance Optimization Analytics Specialist, you will analyse production, testing and maintenance costs, identify financial risks and model future capacity scenarios. You will help Operations Karlskrona use resources and capital efficiently while NKT expands the cable production required for the green transition.







Translate operational costs into informed business decisions



Working within Operation Analytics, you will examine cost factors across production, testing, equipment, maintenance and material flows. You will connect financial information with capacity, staffing and operational forecasts, while considering energy prices, raw materials, inflation and policy developments. Your findings will support budgeting, forecasting, investment calculations and expansion planning.



Your responsibility will be to:




    Analyse cost factors across production, testing and material flows
    Prepare financial forecasts for capacity, staffing, equipment and maintenance
    Identify financial risks and opportunities within operational processes
    Support budgeting, forecasting and investment calculations
    Provide weekly cost signals and quarterly financial scenarios



The position is based in Karlskrona, Sweden, and involves close cooperation with Operations and Finance as well as other operational functions. You will support line organisations in using cost optimisation methods and models. Any travel requirements will be discussed during the recruitment process.





Profile description:

Commercially minded analyst with a practical operational approach



You are structured, curious and able to consider both financial and operational perspectives. You communicate complex findings clearly and enjoy working with colleagues from different functions. You assess assumptions carefully, ask relevant questions and provide balanced recommendations. You also take a collaborative approach to sharing methods and helping operational teams use financial information in everyday decision-making.



You also have:




    Experience analysing operational costs and cost variations
    Knowledge of financial forecasting and scenario planning
    Experience with budgeting and investment calculations
    Understanding of production, testing, maintenance or capacity economics
    Ability to prepare financial decision material from operational data







Support sustainable growth through better resource decisions



We aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths—even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This position provides opportunities for career development, cross-functional collaboration and continued development of your financial and operational skills in an international environment. You will contribute to investment, capacity and resource decisions while learning from colleagues across Operations, Finance and related functions during NKT’s continued expansion.







“As a leader, I value clear analysis that helps our teams identify capacity constraints early and make well-founded operational decisions,” says Hiring Manager, Magnus Röstlund.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 28.09.2026. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process. For inquiries about the recruitment process, please reach out to Dejan Zegarac, Global Talent Attraction Specialist, at Dejan.Zegarac@nkt.com. Please note that due to the GDPR regulations we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.







We collect confidential candidate experience feedback to improve our recruitment process. Your responses are for quality development only and do not affect hiring decisions.

Senior Account Manager
======================

Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused

**Senior Account Manager (100%)**

to join our team. In this role, you will be the key link between our customers and our technical teams, ensuring long\-term partnerships and outstanding customer satisfaction.

At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.

Tasks
-----

**Your role and your responsibilities**

The Senior Account Manager role is responsible for the acquisition of new customers, as well as growth, retention, and strategic development of existing/assigned customer accounts while ensuring a seamless and value\-driven customer experience. Specifically, you will:

* Identify and acquire new customers through outbound and inbound sales activities in close collaboration with our Business Development Representative and the marketing team;
* Manage and grow a portfolio of existing customer accounts (MSPs, ITSPs, large SMBs);
* Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and requests;
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with key stakeholders on the customer side;
* Identify upselling and cross\-selling opportunities to maximize customer lifetime value;
* Own the sales cycle for new customers, from first contact to closing and onboarding;
* Coordinate with internal teams (platform, product, business operations, finance) to deliver solutions;
* Support the onboarding of new customers and ensure smooth implementation;
* Monitor account performance and provide regular reporting and insights;
* Proactively identify risks and resolve issues to maintain high customer satisfaction.


Requirements
------------

The ideal candidate will tick all the following boxes.

**Must\-haves**

* **Relevant work experience:** You have least three years of experience in account management, sales, business development, or customer success in technology company focusing on IT infrastructure \- ideally mid\-market.
* **Technical affinity and know\-how:** You have a solid understanding of the building blocks of IT infrastructure and the cloud. You are familiar with terms such as IaaS, PaaS, public and private cloud, VMs, backup, storage, containers and related topics.
* **Drive \& Ownership:** You are a self\-starter who likes to take matters into your own hand, take responsibility, and persistently work toward results.
* **Matching education:** Bachelor’s degree (or comparable) in Information Systems, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* **(Swiss) German \& English:** You speak both German and English fluently and you are able to communicate confidently and flawlessly in both – in spoken and in written form. Additionally, you are able to effortlessly follow a conversation in Swiss German.
* **Customer Focus:** You keep the customer's interests in sight at all times. Going the extra\-mile for your customers comes naturally to you.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** You thrive in cross\-functional environments, working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders to drive business outcomes.
* **CRM Pro:** You are experience in working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot).
* **Results orientated mindset:** Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.


**Nice\-to\-haves**

* **Entrepreneurial Spirit:** You are characterized by a self\-motivated drive to explore new opportunities, a willingness to take initiative as well as to seek and provide solutions and a strong commitment to contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
* **Sales Management Ambition:** The ambition to develop into a sales management role is seen as a plus. If all goes according to plan, Xelon just might offer you that opportunity once the time is right.
* **Swiss German and other additional Languages:** Any language additional to the required ones is considered a plus; Swiss German is an asset in this role.
* **HubSpot**: Any previous hands\-on experience and/or certification for HubSpot is valuable for this role.
* **AI\-mindset**: Curiosity and openness towards AI\-supported workflows, along with a solid understanding of current AI developments and tools, and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency and outcomes.
* **A feel for processes:** You contribute ideas on how we can further optimize our sales and marketing processes.


Benefits
--------

* **Rewarding compensation:** Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives tied to growth and sales success.
* **Creative freedom:** The opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the growth of a well\-established tech scale\-up.
* **Flexible working hours \& remote options:** Work when and where you are most productive.
* **Innovative environment:** Experience the dynamics of a tech scale\-up with a strong existing customer base. Modern tools and technologies support your work.
* **Young, dynamic team:** Together we achieve our goals and celebrate our successes.


**Join our mission**

Do you feel like you are the person that would complete our team? Are you ready for a new challenge? Then apply now!

We look forward to hearing from you

**The Xelon Team**

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Berikon

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Erwachsenenpsychiatrie

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). - Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Teamleitung

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Teamleitung in Zollikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen mit Teamleitungsfunktion in Zollikon ist äußerst dynamisch und weist eine hohe Nachfrage auf. Ihre Qualifikation wird von Spitälern, Kliniken und Pflegeinstitutionen intensiv gesucht. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen als erfahrener Vermittler den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbinden und den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess professionell begleiten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Zollikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Teamleitung in Zollikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

title: System Architect SAP PM & BTP
description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a System Architect SAP S/4HANA PM \& BTPto shape the future of digital asset lifecycle management for our global B2B customers. In this role, you will own the end-to-end architecture of our Installed Base \& Asset Data Platform, driving integration across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems, data platforms, and IoT solutions. Working closely with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders, you will design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that enable seamless service processes, high-quality asset data, and outstanding customer service outcomes. **This is where you'll excel**
* You define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for the Installed Base \& Asset Data Platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards * You design and optimize integration architectures across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Service Cloud, SAP FSM, Asset Manager, data platforms, and IoT ecosystems * You translate business, functional, and non-functional requirements into robust architecture blueprints, solution designs, and implementation guidelines * You lead architectural governance by conducting design reviews, driving technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with integration, API, and data standards * You collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineering teams, and key stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with the target architecture and strategic roadmap
**These are the skills you'll need**
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related discipline * Proven experience in solution architecture, enterprise application design, and system integration within complex SAP and non-SAP environments, including SAP S/4HANA service processes * Strong expertise in designing architectures for B2B Customer Service asset lifecycle management, with a focus on cross-system integration and scalable solution design * Deep understanding of data and integration architectures, including APIs, event-driven architectures, SAP BW/BDC, data platforms, IoT ecosystems, and cloud-based technologies * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for business audiences and collaborate effectively in distributed agile teams
**Attractive vacation entitlement** Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. **Attractive mobility concept** We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. **VIVA Restaurant** We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. **Employer-funded pension plan** The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch **Health-Port** We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. **Sports activities** We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. **Questions? One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. title: Solution Architect SAP C4C v2
description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a Solution Architect SAP C4C v2 to shape our global CRM landscape based on SAP Sales Cloud v2 and SAP Service Cloud v2. As the architectural lead, you will design scalable and integrated solutions that support Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Digital Customer Experience processes, while ensuring seamless connectivity across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and other enterprise platforms. Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and development teams, you will drive architectural decisions, govern technology standards, and help define the future roadmap of our customer engagement ecosystem. **This is where you'll excel**
* You define and drive the target architecture for Bühler's global CRM platform and Customer Engagement ecosystem * You design scalable integration and data solutions across SAP Sales Cloud v2, SAP Service Cloud v2, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and connected digital platforms * You translate business and technical requirements into solution architectures, implementation roadmaps, and design guidelines * You lead architectural governance, technical decision-making, and ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, integration, and security standards * You collaborate closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to continuously evolve and enhance CRM capabilities

description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Thun suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Thun

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Thun

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Thun liegt malerisch am Thunersee im Berner Oberland und besticht durch hervorragende Verkehrsanbindungen via Bahn und Autobahn. Sie profitieren von kurzen Pendeldistanzen zu regionalen Arbeitszentren und der Nähe zu Bern. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine ausgezeichnete Lebensqualität mit Freizeitmöglichkeiten, während gleichzeitig ein stabiler Arbeitsmarkt mit diversen Branchen vorhanden ist.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Thun

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Thun verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

Développer et entretenir les relations avec les architectes, ingénieurs, maîtres d’ouvrage et autres partenaires du secteur de la construction  
Analyser les projets en phase amont et accompagner les architectes et maîtres d’ouvrage dans la recherche de solutions constructives bois pertinentes, économiques et réalisables

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur·e HES en technique du bois EPFL, d’ingénieur·e civil avec expérience dans le bois ou une formation équivalente  
Vous pouvez justifier d'une expérience professionnelle avérée de plus de 5 ans dans un poste similaire  
Vous maitrisez les logiciels de structures tels que Dlubal RFEM/RSTAB et Cadwork  
Vous êtes capable d’analyser rapidement un projet et de proposer des solutions techniquement pertinentes et économiquement réalistes  
Vous appréciez le contact avec les clients, architectes et partenaires et êtes à l’aise pour présenter et défendre une solution  
Vous communiquez de manière authentique et savez instaurer un climat de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs  
Vos avantages dans ce poste  
Un poste offrant une réelle diversité entre développement de projets, conception \& ingénierie  
La possibilité d’intervenir très tôt dans les projets et d’exercer une influence directe sur les solutions qui seront réalisées  
L’accès aux compétences et aux ressources d’un groupe de construction de plus de 1'400 collaborateurs

Technicien SAV (H/F)
====================

Reconnue et incontournable depuis plus de 40 ans, Multi Personnel est une agence spécialisée dans la mise à disposition de personnel administratif et de cadres, temporaire et fixe, dans de nombreux secteurs économiques, tels que la banque, sociétés financières, multinationales, ONG, PME et institutions locales.  

Nous souhaitons recruter un/e Technicien SAV (H/F)

**Ta mission :**
----------------

* **Dépannage et diagnostic** : identifier l’origine des dysfonctionnements, effectuer les réparations nécessaires, recueillir les informations techniques sur site, réaliser des relevés et croquis, puis transmettre les éléments indispensables à la remise en service des équipements.
* **Maintenance préventive et corrective** : contrôler, analyser et entretenir les installations afin d’assurer leur performance, leur fiabilité et la sécurité des utilisateurs.
* **Installation de nouvelles motorisations** : assurer la pose, l’adaptation, le raccordement et la mise en service de systèmes de motorisation sur différents équipements.
* **Mise en service des installations** : réaliser les raccordements, procéder aux réglages et effectuer les essais nécessaires pour garantir le bon fonctionnement des produits de notre gamme.


**Maintenant si on parlait de toi ?**
-------------------------------------

* Titulaire d’un **CFC d’électromécanicien, d’électricien** ou d’une formation jugée équivalente.
* Expérience confirmée d’au moins **3 ans** dans le diagnostic de pannes et la maintenance d’installations. Une expérience dans le domaine des **portes automatiques** et/ou des **systèmes de quai de chargement** constitue un sérieux atout.
* À l’aise avec les interventions en hauteur ; la possession d’un **permis nacelle et/ou élévateur** est un avantage.
* Bonne maîtrise de la **lecture de schémas électriques** et de plans techniques.
* Titulaire du **permis de conduire catégorie B**.
* Personne **autonome, polyvalente, rigoureuse et organisée**, disposant d’un excellent sens de l’analyse et de la résolution de problèmes.
* Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, avec une communication aisée aussi bien avec les clients qu’avec les différents intervenants du chantier.
* Capacité à assurer le suivi administratif des interventions, notamment la rédaction de rapports et de comptes rendus techniques.
* Flexible et disponible pour assurer des **horaires variables**, y compris les services de piquet, les interventions en soirée ou de nuit.
* Domicilié(e) dans la région ou à proximité.


**Ton interlocuteur/trice :**
-----------------------------

Pour ce poste, tu seras accompagné(e) par Sofia, elle saura t’accompagner, te conseiller et t’apporter la réponse à toutes tes questions concernant le poste. Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est intégrer une organisation engagée où l'accompagnement des bénéficiaires repose sur deux valeurs fortes : ouverture et responsabilité.  
Afin de renforcer nos équipes éducatives sur différentes structures d'hébergement du canton de Vaud, nous recrutons des :  
Éducateurs\-trices sociaux\-ales.

En collaboration avec une équipe interdisciplinaire et avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous êtes un pilier essentiel pour :  
Offrir un cadre de vie sécurisant et bienveillant à de jeunes Mineurs\-es Non Accompagnés\-es (MNA).  
Encourager leur autonomie et leur intégration sociale pour préparer leur avenir.  
Les accompagner dans la réalisation de leurs projets personnels et leur transition vers une vie indépendante.

Maintenir une organisation harmonieuse au sein de la structure, dans le respect des cadres légaux et institutionnels.

title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. - Ensure timely and accurate handling of incoming and outgoing goods and documentation

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Learning Support Assistant 50 %
description:
Lien : https://www.eteach.com/job/learning-support-assistant-1566810

Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Learning Support Assistant
to join the school from: 24.08.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 05.08.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 480 students aged 7 -18 representing 70 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the senior school with a dedicated focus on Year 2-8 students.

The school wishes to appoint a teaching assistant for the junior school to work primarily with students in Years 7 and 8.  Experience of working in an international school context would be a distinct advantage. It is expected that this post will involve supporting approximately 20-30 hours per week. This is a term-time only position.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To support teaching staff in the development and education of pupils including the provision of specialist skills as appropriate.

Support for students (either individually or in groups)
Support the activities of individuals or groups, specifically those with EAL considerations.
Establish and maintain relationships with individual pupils and groups.
Contribute to Individual Education Plans as appropriate.
Support pupils during learning activities.
Promote pupils’ social and emotional development.
Contribute to the health and well-being of pupils.
Provide support for bilingual/multilingual pupils (where appropriate to the focus of the role).
Support children with specific needs (where appropriate to the focus of the role), for example, sensory and/or physical impairment, cognitive or learning difficulties, behavioural, emotional and social development needs, communication and interaction difficulties.
Support for Gifted and Talented pupils.
Support pupils with their literacy and numeracy skills.
Support pupils to access the curriculum.
Dealing with the personal care needs of children where appropriate in line with the guidance of the school.

Support for the teacher(s)
Observe and report on pupil performance.
Contribute to the planning and evaluation of learning activities.
Assist in preparing and maintaining the learning environment.
Contribute to the management of pupils’ behaviour.
Contribute to maintaining pupils’ records.
Support the maintenance of pupils’ safety and security.
Supervise the whole class for a short time in an emergency (normally for a period less than a whole lesson until the teacher returns or alternative arrangements are made) or for a very short period of planned absence for less than a whole lesson.
Undertake routine marking in line with the school policy.
Provide administrative support, e.g. produce worksheets, invigilate examinations, etc.

Support for the School
Support the development and effectiveness of team work within the school environment.
Develop and maintain working relationships with other professionals.
Liaise with parents as appropriate.
Review and develop your own professional practice.

Support for the curriculum
Support the use of information and communication technology in the classroom.
Have a responsibility for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people he/she is responsible for or comes into contact with.
To ensure tasks are carried out with due regard to Health and Safety.
To participate in appropriate professional development including adhering to the principle of appraisal/performance management.
To adhere to the ethos of Aiglon and promote the agreed vision and aims of the school while setting an example of personal integrity and professionalism.
Attendance at appropriate staff meetings, parents/open evenings, etc.
Any other duties as commensurate within the grade in order to ensure the smooth running of Aiglon.
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Deputy Head of the Junior School to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

Fachspezialist Reporting \& Datenmanagement

### Setzen Sie sich gemeinsam mit uns für eine menschlichere Welt ein!

Der **Stab Reporting \& Services** sucht per **1\. Dezember 2026** oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als **Fachspezialist:in Reporting \& Datenmanagement 80%.**

* Verantwortung für die Erfassung, Qualitätssicherung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Leistungs\- und Finanzdaten der Rotkreuz\-Kantonalverbände sowie der Rettungsorganisationen
