title: Responsable informatique
employer: Réseau Santé et Social de la Gruyère
description:
Le Réseau Santé et Social de la Gruyère (RSSG) est une association de droit public réunissant les communes du district. De par ses buts statutaires, il exploite le Service d’aide et de soins à domicile, le Service social et exploite deux établissements médico\-sociaux.

Suite au futur départ du titulaire, le Réseau Santé et Social de la Gruyère met au concours le poste de :



**Responsable informatique**  

Dans ce rôle stratégique et transversal, vous pilotez la transition numérique de notre institution en garantissant un système d’information (SI) robuste, sécurisé et parfaitement aligné avec nos missions médico\-sociales. Interlocuteur privilégié de la Direction, vous apportez une vision globale pour arbitrer les choix technologiques et traduire les besoins métiers en solutions d'architecture fiables et pérennes.

**Vos responsabilités principales**

Stratégie, gouvernance \& management

* **Définir et piloter** la stratégie et l'architecture globale du système d'information.
* **Garantir la cohérence** de l’écosystème applicatif, des infrastructures et de la gestion des données.
* **Manager et développer** une équipe interne de 3 collaborateurs, tout en favorisant un esprit d'innovation.
* **Élaborer le budget IT** annuel, contrôler les dépenses et optimiser les investissements.


Sécurité, souveraineté \& gestion des risques

* **Inculquer et faire appliquer** la politique de sécurité informatique et de protection des données (LPD), en collaboration avec les instances concernées.
* **Placer la souveraineté numérique** au cœur des choix technologiques (évaluation de la dépendance fournisseurs, réversibilité des solutions, maîtrise des coûts à long terme).
* **Superviser la conformité**, suivre les risques IT et coordonner les audits de sécurité ainsi que les dispositifs de nos prestataires.
* **Prioriser et suivre** les projets IT en adaptant l’approche méthodologique au contexte et aux enjeux réels de l'institution.
* **Accompagner le changement** auprès des équipes et assurer le lien avec les profils non techniques.
* **Gérer les relations contractuelles** et évaluer la performance des prestataires et partenaires tiers.


**Gestion de l'écosystème applicatif \& Données**

* Assurer la pérennité, l'évolution et l'intégration de nos solutions clés : M\-Files (GED), ProConcept (ERP), JBM (gestion des temps),CareFolio (@Home et LongTerm) et Kiss (service social).
* Définir et faire appliquer les principes de gestion, de qualité et d'intégrité des données.


**Gestion budgétaire et contrôle**

* Élaborer le budget IT annuel et contrôler rigoureusement les dépenses.
* Analyser les écarts budgétaires et optimiser les coûts globaux du système d'information.
* Valider l'ensemble des investissements matériels et logiciels.


**Votre profil :**

* **Formation \& Vision globale :** Formation supérieure en informatique (HES, EPF, Brevet/Diplôme fédéral) ou parcours jugé équivalent. Vous possédez une compréhension large de toute la chaîne IT (systèmes, réseaux, cybersécurité/cyberdéfense, environnements logiciels).
* **Expérience :** Minimum 5 ans d’expérience réussie dans la gestion de systèmes d’information, le management d'équipe et la conduite de projets complexes. Une expérience dans le secteur public ou de la santé en Suisse constitue un solide atout.
* **Compétences stratégiques :**Capacité éprouvée à imaginer des architectures physiques, virtuelles et logicielles et évaluer des solutions complexes sous l'angle des risques et de la souveraineté des données.
* **Langues :** Parfaite maîtrise du français (langue de travail). Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais technique et capacité confirmée à communiquer oralement en anglais.
* **Qualités personnelles :** Posture de leader, esprit analytique et créatif, forte capacité d'arbitrage et de négociation. Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre aisance relationnelle et votre faculté à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès de la Direction.


**Ce que nous offrons :**

La possibilité de rejoindre une institution dynamique, en pleine évolution, qui propose des conditions de travail selon le statut du personnel de l’Etat de Fribourg et des conditions sociales attrayantes.

**Lieu de travail** : Bulle, Canton de Fribourg

**Entrée en fonction** : à convenir

Pour toutes questions relatives au poste, Monsieur Benjamin Menoud, Directeur général, reste volontiers à votre disposition.

Position System Administrator / IT\-Security Engineer (m/f/d)
=============================================================

Location: **Switzerland** \| Department: **IT Development \& Operations**\| Reports to: **Head of Infrastructure** \| Employment Type: **Full\-time** \| Management Responsibility: **None**



**Organization**

Established by the Financial Stability Board in June 2014, the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is a not\-for\-profit organization created to support the implementation and use of the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI). GLEIF manages a network of partners, the LEI issuing organizations, to provide trusted services and open, reliable data for unique legal entity identification worldwide. GLEIF services ensure the operational integrity of the Global LEI System and facilitate making the LEI a broad public good available on our website. As a result, the LEI remains the industry standard best suited to providing open and reliable data for unique legal entity identification management. Learn more at



**Why us?**

What our new colleagues can expect:

* A quick job entry
* A permanent employment contract
* Performance\-related salary model with an attractive compensation
* Flexible and mobile working environment
* A patient and comprehensive induction programme
* Regular town halls and feedback meetings
* Leadership with empathy
* Short decision\-making processes
* Comprehensive further training and talent development and access to online learning Platforms (e.g. Pluralsight, Laracast)
* Company iPhone \& Macbook


This is an opportunity to make an impact on the transparency of the financial services and other industries in a not\-for\-profit, stable business that is committed to investing in the foundation, its partner relationships, and its employees. You will join a highly motivated team with the mission to successfully implement the Global Legal Entity Identifier system. Compensation and benefits will be of course adequate to the position.



**Position summary**

The System Administrator / IT\-Security Engineer will, operate and support the GLEIF server environment and network infrastructure in line with GLEIF policies and procedures. The individual will work closely with the User Administrators in Frankfurt and will support the corporate IT in this role. The individual is responsible for the quality, scope, effort and timeliness of provided services. We seek an individual with the ambition and skill to work in a highly motivated team.



**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical management and patching of software applications and infrastructure
* Design, implementation and operation of SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Continuous improvement of monitoring strategies for new vulnerabilities to IT security
* Evaluation of new software updates and patch management, to ensure and maintain IT security of GLEIF systems
* Management and performance tuning of databases (MySQL/MariaDB)
* Investigation and solving of technical issues
* Create and maintain technical documentation of configurations and procedures
* Collaborate with Project Managers and Developers • Provide direct support to Software Developers and IT staff
* Work with outsourcing and cloud partners regarding external IT infrastructure and interfaces




**Experience and competencies for success**

* At least 3\+ years of experience with professional systems operating (e.g. LAMP stack)
* Excellent Linux command line skills, especially bash and ansible scripting
* Experience with highly available, distributed and virtualized systems •
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP and load balancing
* Experience in managing MariaDB databases and Galera clusters (including backup, restore, replication, ….)
* • Familiarity with CI/CD and utilization of appropriate tools (preferably GitLab CI)
* Ability to leverage various tools for systems/infrastructure monitoring (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana)
* Knowledge of security principles and best practices
* Very good analytical thinking and understanding of processes
* University degree in Computer Science or similar preferred
* Possessing team spirit and good communication skills
* Flexible and able to work in a dynamic work environment
* Fluent spoken and written English

title: Oberärztin, Oberarzt für Innere Medizin, Notfallmedizin Region Bern (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description:
Die Spitäler in in dieser Region sind Weiterbildungskliniken der ersten Kategorie, wo erstklassige medizinische Qualität und das Wohl des Menschen im Mittelpunkt steht. Die fachlichen Schwerpunkte sind die "Allgemeine Innere Medizin", Akutgeriatrie, Kardiologie, Onkologie, Neurologie, Nephrologie, Gastroenterologie, Angiologie, Pneumologie, Hämatologie, Endokrinologie, Dermatologie (konsiliarisch) und die Notfallmedizin, in der das ganze Spektrum der Disziplin Allgemeine Innere Medizin und der interdisziplinären klinischen Notfallmedizin abgedeckt wird.

Für diesen äußerst interessanten Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder Vereinbarung eine fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Person als

Oberärztin, Oberarzt für Innere Medizin, Notfallmedizin in der Berner Region

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

- Sie übernehmen die fachliche Organisation sowie das Management des Notfallbetriebs und agieren als zentrale Ansprechperson zwischen Zuweisern und Klinik
- Sie stellen eine qualitativ hochwertige, patientennahe Versorgung sicher und koordinieren die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit
- Teilnahme an ärztlichen Hintergrunddiensten, ohne nächtliche Präsenz
- Führen und unterstützen der Assistenzärzte sowie Studierende in Ausbildung und Weiterbildung
- Medizinische Leistungserfassung und zuständig für das Berichtswesen sowie der Optimierung bestehender Abläufe
- Bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und ärztliche Ansprechperson für stationäre Belange

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Abgeschlossene Facharztweiterbildung Innere Medizin sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen (EU-Facharzttitel,
EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen bei Stellenantritt nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch unmittelbar danach und mit unserer Unterstützung eingereicht werden
- Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit
- Sicherstellung der ärztlichen Versorgung von Patienten und Patientinnen innerhalb eines Teams der Inneren Medizin
- Mitarbeit auf der Notfallstation, den Bettenstationen, der Tagesklinik und der interdisziplinären Intensivstation
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Fixgehalt zwischen CHF 150.000 und CHF 180.000 brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit, je nach Berufserfahrung, Alter, Aus- und Weiterbildung.
- Zeit Zuschläge für Nacht- und Schichtdienste sowie Überzeit gem. den allgemeinen Anstellungsbedingungen
- Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 42 Stunden
- Zwischen 25 und 35 bezahlte Urlaubstage pro Jahr, je nach Alter

Sie schätzen Herausforderungen, wollen neue Ziele erreichen und stellen sich gerne anspruchsvollen Aufgaben?

Es erwartet Sie ein interessantes, vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet in einem engagierten und motivierten Team. Dieser Arbeitsort ist ein innovatives und zukunftsgerichtetes Spitalzentrum mit attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen sowie persönlichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wir unterstützen Sie gern

Unser Team vor Ort coacht und begleitet Sie durch den kompletten Bewerbungsprozess und wir helfen Ihnen bei Erlangung der MEBEKO-Anerkennung durch das SRK. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir Sie bei der Relocation in die Schweiz und bei praktischen Fragen (Anmeldung, Bankkonto, Versicherung etc.).

Wir garantieren Ihnen dabei absolute Diskretion.

Kontakte

Haben Sie ein ernstes Interesse an diesem Stellenangebot, so freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung an swissmedical@wa-jobs.de zu Händen Herrn Uwe Bludau.

Bitte senden Sie folgende Unterlagen mit:
Ihren Lebenslauf mit Foto, ggf. Referenzen und Befähigungsnachweise (Approbation).

Gerne beantworten wir Ihre Fragen auch vorab telefonisch unter:
0049 30 34 33 16 67.
Internet: swissmedical.wa-jobs.de
E-Mail: swissmedical@wa-jobs.de

Unsere Stellenausschreibungen richten sich stets an alle berufsfähigen Menschen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung, Religion und Weltanschauung etc. Die Bewerberauswahl erfolgt ausschließlich qualifikationsorientiert.
Irrtümer in den Angaben und der Schreibweise vorbehalten.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

Our company benefits vary based on your location, but always include:

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action
- President’s Club: Recognition awarded by leadership and your peers
- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship
- Lifelong education: A variety of training and development opportunities
- Hire to Grow: We optimize our internal structures and feedback culture constantly to be your Employer of Choice, today and in future
- You can find all current benefits here: https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits (https://www.softwareone.com/de-at/karriere/dach/benefits)

Have we piqued your interest?

Then apply with your CV and a few clicks via our online form! No cover letter is necessary.

Do you have any questions? Then feel free to send us an email at malte.ruetten@softwareone.com.

Für diese Herausforderungen in einem stark wachsenden Markt suchen wir Mitarbeiter*innen zur Verstärkung unseres neuen Standortes und jungen Teams in der Schweiz.

- Verantwortung für Terminplanung, Kostenschätzung und Qualität
- Sicherstellung der Projektkommunikation zu allen Stakeholdern
- Kundenpflege und Gewinnung von Projekten

Unsere Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches, Ingenieur- oder pharmazeutisches Studium oder adäquate technische Ausbildung
- Mehrjährige Berufs- und Projektierungserfahrung in der Life-Science Industrie
- Starke Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitern und Projektteams
- Fundierte Erfahrung mit Technologien zur Produktion von pharmazeutischen / biopharmazeutischen Produkten
- Selbständiger, strukturierter und teamorientierter Arbeitsstil
- Sehr gut in Deutsch und Englisch
- Bereitschaft zur Reisetätigkeit

Ihre Vorteile:

- Teamspirit: Außergewöhnlicher kollegialer Zusammenhalt bei flacher Hierarchie
- Firmenevents: Bei vielen gemeinsamen Unternehmungen wie z.B. Betriebsausflügen feiern wir Erfolge und Gemeinschaft.
- Karriere: Individuelle Laufbahnplanung und persönliche Förderung
- Sonderleistungen: Wir teilen den Erfolg gerne mit zusätzlichen Leistungen!
- Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit und des Arbeitsorts: Wir bieten verschiedene Teilzeitmodelle auch in Führungspositionen, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten, damit Beruf und Familie in Einklang gebracht werden können


Wir bieten Ihnen attraktive Rahmenbedingungen, ein Team aus hochmotivierten und hilfsbereiten Kolleg*innen, das Sie beim Einstieg und Ihrer persönlichen Weiterentwicklung in die Pharmaindustrie unterstützt und von dessen Know-How Sie innerhalb kürzester Zeit profitieren werden. title: Operations Specialist
description:
Millennium Management is a global hedge fund with more than 6,000 employees and offices in the United States, Europe and Asia.  We were founded in 1989, and we employ a global multi-strategy investment approach, opportunistically engaging in a broad array of trading and investing strategies. Millennium has differentiated itself from other investment management firms through our consistent ability over the last 35 years to generate returns that have not been correlated to the general market.

The talent and dedication of our people are critical to our success. We offer an opportunity for developing one’s professional career while working with individuals trained in a variety of disciplines in a collegial and dynamic environment. We also offer a broad range of competitive benefits on a global basis.

General Information

Hiring Department/Group: Equities
Role: Operations Specialist
Office Location: Zug (CH)
Job Function Summary

The successful candidate will support the Equities Volatility business through robust derivatives trade management and post-trade operations oversight. They will manage the end-to-end lifecycle for listed derivatives activity, ensuring accurate trade capture, allocations, clearing, reconciliations, and exception resolution. The role requires strong control discipline, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, risk-sensitive environment.

Principal Responsibilities

Oversee end-to-end listed derivatives trade lifecycle, including trade capture, allocations, clearing, and position management.
Monitor and resolve exchange vs. books and records breaks across trades, positions, and cash.
Manage internal and external position transfers, give-ups / give-ins, and clearing broker coordination.
Support regulatory and exchange reporting requirements, including control enhancements and exception management.
Partner with PMs, trading desks, brokers, exchanges, and internal teams to ensure accurate operational support.
Drive STP improvement, process efficiency, and operational scalability across the platform.
Qualifications/Skills Required

10+ years’ experience in listed derivatives operations, trade management, clearing, and reconciliations.
Strong knowledge of exchange-traded derivatives lifecycle and post-trade controls across EMEA and as well as US markets.
Experience managing exceptions, regulatory reporting, and exchange / CCP-related operational processes.
Strong stakeholder management skills across trading, client service, compliance, brokers, and vendors.
Experience working across global teams and supporting change, migrations, and new product onboarding.

title: System Architect SAP PM & BTP
description:
To strengthen our IT department, we are looking for a System Architect SAP S/4HANA PM \& BTPto shape the future of digital asset lifecycle management for our global B2B customers. In this role, you will own the end-to-end architecture of our Installed Base \& Asset Data Platform, driving integration across SAP and non-SAP ecosystems, data platforms, and IoT solutions. Working closely with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders, you will design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that enable seamless service processes, high-quality asset data, and outstanding customer service outcomes. **This is where you'll excel**
* You define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for the Installed Base \& Asset Data Platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with enterprise architecture standards * You design and optimize integration architectures across SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, Service Cloud, SAP FSM, Asset Manager, data platforms, and IoT ecosystems * You translate business, functional, and non-functional requirements into robust architecture blueprints, solution designs, and implementation guidelines * You lead architectural governance by conducting design reviews, driving technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with integration, API, and data standards * You collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineering teams, and key stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions aligned with the target architecture and strategic roadmap

title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Commissioning, Qualification & Validation Professionals – Switzerland
description:
Location: Switzerland – project locations may include Basel, Visp and other major pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs
Employment Type: Permanent and Contract Opportunities
Company: KPC International
KPC International is expanding its presence in Switzerland and is interested in speaking with experienced Commissioning, Qualification and Validation professionals for current and upcoming pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical projects.
We support major capital projects from strategy and design through commissioning, qualification, start-up and operational readiness. Opportunities may be available across both project leadership and hands-on execution roles.
Areas of Interest
We welcome applications from professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas:
•    Commissioning and Qualification leadership
•    Clean and black utilities
•    HVAC and cleanrooms
•    Drug substance and drug product manufacturing
•    Fill-finish and aseptic processing
•    Buffer and media preparation
•    CIP and SIP systems
•    Upstream and downstream process equipment
•    Laboratory and analytical equipment
•    Automation and Computer System Validation
•    Thermal mapping
•    Qualification documentation and document generation
•    Quality Assurance and validation oversight
•    KNEAT, Veeva or other electronic validation systems


Typical Responsibilities
Depending on the assignment, responsibilities may include:
•    Developing and implementing commissioning and qualification strategies
•    Preparing, reviewing and executing lifecycle documentation
•    Supporting DQ, FAT, SAT, commissioning, IQ, OQ and PQ activities
•    Reviewing URS, specifications, risk assessments and traceability matrices
•    Managing deviations, punch items and qualification close-out
•    Coordinating with engineering, quality, automation, vendors and operations teams
•    Providing technical leadership across assigned systems or workstreams
•    Supporting inspection readiness and compliance with applicable GMP requirements

Candidate Profile
We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
•    Experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated manufacturing environments
•    Practical commissioning, qualification or validation experience
•    A strong understanding of GMP requirements and the project lifecycle
•    The ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams
•    Strong technical documentation and communication skills
•    Professional fluency in English
German or French language skills, experience working in Switzerland and familiarity with Swiss pharmaceutical manufacturing sites would be advantageous but are not essential for every position.
Work Eligibility
Applications are welcome from candidates already authorised to work in Switzerland, EU/EFTA nationals and other experienced professionals who may require work-permit support.
Any potential work-permit or relocation requirements will be reviewed individually and will depend on the position, project location, candidate experience and applicable Swiss immigration requirements.
About KPC International
KPC International has supported pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical projects worldwide since 2001. Our teams provide specialist engineering, commissioning, qualification, validation and project delivery services from concept through start-up and operation.
We offer the opportunity to work on technically challenging projects with leading life-sciences organisations, supported by an experienced international team.
Apply
Please submit your CV together with the following information:
•    Current location
•    Swiss work authorisation or nationality
•    Availability or notice period
•    Preferred employment type
•    Relevant technical disciplines
•    Expected salary or contract rate
Applications will be reviewed against both current and upcoming opportunities in Switzerland.

Established by the Financial Stability Board in June 2014, the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is a not\-for\-profit organization created to support the implementation and use of the Legal Entity Identifier (LEI). GLEIF manages a network of partners, the LEI issuing organizations, to provide trusted services and open, reliable data for unique legal entity identification worldwide. GLEIF services ensure the operational integrity of the Global LEI System and facilitate making the LEI a broad public good available on our website. As a result, the LEI remains the industry standard best suited to providing open and reliable data for unique legal entity identification management. Learn more at



**Why us?**

* A quick job entry
* A permanent employment contract
* Performance\-related salary model with an attractive compensation

The System Administrator / IT\-Security Engineer will, operate and support the GLEIF server environment and network infrastructure in line with GLEIF policies and procedures. The individual will work closely with the User Administrators in Frankfurt and will support the corporate IT in this role. * • Familiarity with CI/CD and utilization of appropriate tools (preferably GitLab CI)

title: Kfz-Sachverständiger (m/w/d) (Kraftfahrzeugsachverständige/r)
description:
Die Wele Personal Service GmbH ist ein Unternehmen der Personaldienstleistung mit den Hauptgeschäftsfeldern Arbeitnehmerüberlassung und Personalvermittlung.

In diesem Zusammenhang suchen wir für ein Unternehmen im Raum Jena motivierte und zuverlässige Mitarbeiter/innen.

Ihre Aufgaben sind:

- Fachliche Begutachtung von Fahrzeugen mit Hagelschäden
- Prüfung und Plausibilisierung der durch den Hagelscanner erfassten Schäden
- Zuordnung der Schäden zu den einzelnen Karosseriebauteilen
- Erkennen und Abgrenzen von Hagelschäden gegenüber Vorschäden, Gebrauchsspuren und anderen Beschädigungen
- Beurteilung von Anzahl, Größe, Lage und Ausprägung der Hageldellen
- Entscheidung über den technisch und wirtschaftlich geeigneten Reparaturweg
- Beurteilung, ob eine lackschadenfreie Ausbeultechnik/PDR, Klebetechnik, Vordrücken mit anschließender Lackierung oder gegebenenfalls Austausch bzw. konventionelle Instandsetzung erforderlich ist
- Berücksichtigung von notwendigen De-/Montagearbeiten, Verbundarbeiten und Besonderheiten des jeweiligen Fahrzeugs
- Erstellung einer vollständigen und nachvollziehbaren Hagelschadenkalkulation z.Bsp. SilverDAT 3 / DAT
- Anwendung der aktuellen BVAT-Kalkulationsvorgaben für Hagelschäden
- Fahrzeugidentifikation über VIN und Kontrolle der Fahrzeugausstattung
- Dokumentation der Schäden und Kalkulation für Auftraggeber bzw. Schadenabwicklung
- Qualitätskontrolle der erstellten Kalkulation vor Abschluss des Fahrzeugvorgangs

Zwingende Voraussetzung ist praktische Erfahrung in der Beurteilung und Kalkulation von Hagelschäden.

Gesucht werden beispielsweise Bewerber mit Hintergrund als:

- Kfz-Sachverständiger / Kfz-Schadengutachter
- Karosserie- und Fahrzeugbauer bzw. Karosseriebaumeister
- Kfz-Meister mit Erfahrung in Karosserie- und Unfallschäden
- erfahrener Schadenkalkulator aus Versicherung, Sachverständigenbüro oder Karosseriebetrieb
- Hagelschaden-Spezialist / PDR-Spezialist mit fundierter Kalkulationserfahrung.

Zusätzlich zwingend erforderlich:

- sichere Beurteilung von Hagel- und Karosserieschäden
- Erfahrung mit Hagelschadenkalkulation
- sehr gute Kenntnisse in DAT / SilverDAT 3, idealerweise im Bereich Hagelkalkulation
- Kenntnisse der BVAT-Kalkulationssystematik
- Verständnis von Karosserieaufbau, Lackierung und Ausbeultechnik
- Fähigkeit, einen vom Scanner festgestellten Schaden eigenständig fachlich zu überprüfen
- selbstständige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
- sicherer Umgang mit PC und digitaler Schadenaufnahme.

Wir bieten:

- kostenfreie Unterkunft für die Dauer des Einsatzes
- tägliche Auslöse
- Verpflegung inklusive (exkl. Abendessen)
- Übernahme der Fahrkosten für An- und Abreise
- moderner, stationärer Arbeitsplatz mit Hagelschaden-Scanner
- klar strukturierte Schadenaufnahme
- längerfristiger Einsatz bei entsprechendem Projektvolumen.

title: Security Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace (IT-Administrator/in)
description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

Secruity Engineer (gn) Microsoft Modern Workplace

- Do you want to design modern Microsoft 365 environments holistically and advise customers on everything from collaboration strategy to security, compliance, and Copilot?
- Are you equally comfortable with technical and conceptual topics and ready to take ownership in diverse customer projects?
- Are you looking for an environment where you can work cross-functionally, help shape innovation, and create real value together with Sales, Delivery, and technology partners?

Practical information:
Location: Romandie-Switzerland | Working model: Hybrid | Seniority: Senior | Language requirements: Very good written and spoken French and English

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization
- Design, implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Defender XDR solutions including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
- AZ-500 – Azure Security Engineer
- MS-102 – Microsoft 365 Administrator
- Additional Microsoft Security, Azure, Purview, Sentinel, Copilot or Security Copilot etc. certifications are a plus

- Global company culture: We defined our 6 core values through our company culture (https://www.softwareone.com/en/our-story/our-values)
- A mentor who supports your successful start and is at your side with advice and action

- Flexible work: Do great work from anywhere but also visit local office to deliver excellence in team relationship

Senior Account Manager
======================

Welcome to **Xelon** – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for a motivated and customer\-focused

**Senior Account Manager (100%)**

to join our team. In this role, you will be the key link between our customers and our technical teams, ensuring long\-term partnerships and outstanding customer satisfaction.

At **Xelon**, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From **IaaS** to **SaaS**, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like **technology**, **finance, insurance, and public services**. Our solutions \- **Xelon Cloud**, **Xelon Secure\+** and **Xelon HQ** combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one are on a mission to become the **\#1 Swiss Cloud Enabler**, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.

Tasks
-----

**Your role and your responsibilities**

The Senior Account Manager role is responsible for the acquisition of new customers, as well as growth, retention, and strategic development of existing/assigned customer accounts while ensuring a seamless and value\-driven customer experience. Specifically, you will:

* Build strong, long\-term relationships with key stakeholders on the customer side;

* **HubSpot**: Any previous hands\-on experience and/or certification for HubSpot is valuable for this role.
* **AI\-mindset**: Curiosity and openness towards AI\-supported workflows, along with a solid understanding of current AI developments and tools, and a willingness to leverage them to improve efficiency and outcomes.
* **A feel for processes:** You contribute ideas on how we can further optimize our sales and marketing processes.

--------

* **Rewarding compensation:** Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives tied to growth and sales success.
* **Creative freedom:** The opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the growth of a well\-established tech scale\-up.
* **Flexible working hours \& remote options:** Work when and where you are most productive.
* **Innovative environment:** Experience the dynamics of a tech scale\-up with a strong existing customer base. Modern tools and technologies support your work.
* **Young, dynamic team:** Together we achieve our goals and celebrate our successes.

We look forward to hearing from you

title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
description:
Company Description

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine, and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist (m/f/d) with deep expertise in developing multi-omics data integration and machine learnings methods, to join our Digital & Data Science Group in Biologicals Research. Biologicals research discovers, characterizes, optimizes and produces novel biologicals. Biologicals are derived from nature. They can be naturally occurring microbes, extracts or molecules protecting plants from pests and diseases or improving plant and soil health.
Within this role you will work on Syngenta ‘omics data to identify patterns in product performance and make predictions. You will be asked to develop methods to analyze and interpret the outcome of ‘omics experiments with your analytical skills as well as machine learning approaches. Your work will result in new tools to guide selection, optimization and development of novel Biologicals solutions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and implement new multi-omics integration strategies (e.g., data harmonization, feature engineering, network-based methods) to strengthen biological interpretation and hypothesis generation
Apply and advance machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI approaches to extract insights from complex, high‑dimensional, multi‑omics datasets
Curate, quality control, and integrate large scale ’omics datasets, ensuring data integrity, reproducibility, and downstream analytical readiness
Evaluate and develop new data analysis tools, validate findings using a trial and iterative approach, and effectively communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Identify data needs and provide recommendations to scientists to ensure the quantity and verify the integrity of data used for analyses
Work collaboratively to deliver new approaches, share learnings, and drive innovation in digital and data science including technology foresight
Work with R&D IT and software developers to deploy predictive model applications tailored to stakeholder needs
Support business users with change management initiatives to manage data more effectively

Qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or related field with some experience in natural sciences (e.g. chemical biology, microbiology, ecology, environmental sciences)
3+ years developing multi-omics integration methods for complex biological, biochemical, environmental, or agricultural datasets
Strong proficiency in Python and/or R, UNIX/Linux environments, ML frameworks, SQL
Experience with proteomics and metabolomics data analysis would be an asset
Dynamic personality with passion for innovation and problem-solving

Additional information:

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits such as Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance
Please send your complete application with CV, a motivation letter that highlights your motivation and relevant experience for this position, diploma and work certificates (if applicable) in English. Additionally, we welcome access to git repositories showcasing relevant past projects. We will only consider applications that contain CV and motivation letters.

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Relationship Officer - Nachlässe
description:
Join MSF OCG as Relationship Officer - Nachlässe!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.
Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
Als Relationship Officer Nachlässe sind Sie Teil des Teams General Public Fundraising, das zur Abteilung Kommunikation & Fundraising von Ärzte ohne Grenzen Schweiz gehört.
In dieser Funktion sind Sie Hauptansprechpartner:in von Ärzte ohne Grenzen Schweiz für Personen, die Interesse bekundet oder bereits bestätigt haben, die Organisation in ihrem Nachlass zu berücksichtigen (Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors). Sie bauen zu diesen Personen eine vertrauensvolle, persönliche und langfristige Beziehung auf und stehen ihnen während des gesamten Prozesses professionell zur Seite.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Nachlassteam sorgen Sie dafür, die Bedürfnisse und Erwartungen der Spender:innen zu ermitteln, die entsprechenden Massnahmen zu koordinieren und gleichbleibend hohe Qualität in der Betreuung zu gewährleisten.
Sie arbeiten zudem eng mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer zusammen, um ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel von Marketingaktivitäten, Massnahmen zur Gewinnung neuer Spender:innen sowie Beziehungsmanagement und Stewardship sicherzustellen und zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung des Spendenprozesses beizutragen.
Schliesslich tragen Sie zur Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der Tätigkeiten im Nachlassbereich bei. Dazu verwalten und bearbeiten Sie die Daten im CRM, analysieren relevante Kennzahlen, erstellen Berichte und stellen die finanzielle Überwachung der Aktivitäten sicher.
Verantwortungsbereich
Pflege der Beziehungen zu den Spender:innen und Stewardship
•    Hauptansprechpartner:in von Personen, die Interesse bekundet oder bereits bestätigt haben, die Organisation in ihrem Nachlass zu berücksichtigen (Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors)
•    Verwaltung und Ausbau eines Portfolios von Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors durch individuelle und kompetente Betreuung
•    Aufbau und Pflege einer langfristigen und vertrauensvollen Beziehung zu potenziellen und bestehenden Spender:innen
•    Ermittlung der Erwartungen, Beweggründe und Bedürfnisse der Spender:innen und entsprechende Anpassung der Massnahmen im Bereich Stewardship
•    Beantworten von allgemeinen Anfragen zum Thema Nachlass und Weiterleiten von rechtlichen, technischen oder vermögensrechtlichen Fragen an die Senior Legal Officers
•    Organisation von Terminen, Telefongesprächen oder Besuchen zur Pflege und zum Ausbau der Kontakte
•    Präsentation von Projekten, Aktivitäten und der Wirkung der Arbeit von Ärzte ohne Grenzen, um über den Auftrag der Organisation ausführlich zu informieren und das langfristige Engagement zu stärken.
•    Sicherstellen einer angenehmen, persönlichen und kompetenten Betreuung während des gesamten Prozesses
Kontaktpflege, Veranstaltungen und Spender:innenbindung
•    Konzeption und Umsetzung von Massnahmen zur Kontaktpflege und Betreuung von potenziellen Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Konzeption, Planung und Organisation von Veranstaltungen im Nachlassbereich (Vorträge, Treffen, Besuche, Dankesveranstaltungen usw.)
•    Komplette Organisation der Veranstaltungen: Von der Planung und Suche nach geeigneten Orten über Einladungen, Bearbeitung der Anmeldungen und Koordination von Referent:innen und Dienstleister:innen bis hin zur Organisation von Verpflegung oder Kommunikationsmaterial sowie der Nachbearbeitung
•    Erarbeiten von neuen Massnahmen und Formaten zur Stärkung der Spender:innenbindung
•    Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Verbesserung der «Donor Journeys» – sämtlichen Kontaktpunkten der Spender.innen mit der Organisation
Zusammenarbeit mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer  
•    Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der:dem Legacy Marketing Officer, um ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel von Marketingaktivitäten, Massnahmen zur Gewinnung neuer Spender:innen, dem Beziehungsaufbau und der Pflege bestehender Spender:innen sicherzustellen
•    Betreuung der neuen Spender:innen aus Kampagnen und Marketingmassnahmen im Nachlassbereich
•    Rückmeldungen, Erkenntnisse und aus dem Austausch mit potenziellen und bestehenden Spender:innen ermittelte Bedürfnisse weitermelden, um zur Verbesserung von Kampagnen, Kommunikationsinhalten und -tools beizutragen
•    Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung von Inhalten, Tools und Kommunikationsmassnahmen für potenzielle Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Beitrag zur Evaluierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Marketingmassnahmen und bei der Betreuung der Spender:innen
CRM, Portfolio-Betreuung und interne Koordination
•    Betreuung des Portfolios aus potenziellen Spender:innen, Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors im CRM
•    Sicherstellen der Qualität, Vollständigkeit und Aktualität der personenbezogenen Daten, der Interaktionen und Folgemassnahmen
•    Systematische Verfolgung der Entwicklung des Portfolios; Weitergabe relevanter Informationen an das Nachlassteam
•    Förderung von Austausch und Zusammenarbeit zwischen den verschiedenen Teams, damit die Spender:innen optimal betreut werden
•    Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Legal Officers: Weiterleiten von Anfragen, die rechtliches, technisches oder vermögensrechtliches Fachwissen erfordern, an Letztere
•    Strukturierte Weitergabe sämtlicher wichtiger Informationen an die Senior Legal Officers bei einem Erbfall, um einen nahtlosen Übergang von der Spender:innenbeziehung zur rechtlichen Abwicklung des Nachlasses zu gewährleisten
Analyse und Reporting
•    Erfassen und Erstellen der wichtigsten Kennzahlen in den Bereichen Beziehungsmanagement, Spender:innenpflege und -betreuung
•    Analyse des Portfolios, insbesondere hinsichtlich Pipeline, Konversion, Segmentierung, Engagement und der Entwicklung von Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Erstellung regelmässiger Berichte für das Team und die Geschäftsleitung
•    Identifizierung von Trends und Verwertung des aus den Daten generierten Wissens; Formulierung entsprechender Empfehlungen zur Verbesserung der Spender:innenerfahrung und der Wirksamkeit der Aktivitäten
•    Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Abläufe, Tools und Methoden der Datenverarbeitung
Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung des Nachlassbereichs
•    Mitwirkung an der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Strategie des Nachlassteams bei Ärzte ohne Grenzen Schweiz, insbesondere in den Bereichen Beziehungsmanagement und Stewardship.
•    Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung eines einheitlichen Konzepts für die Beziehungspflege und die Betreuung von Handraisers und Confirmed Bequestors
•    Ermittlung und Vorschlagen von neuen Massnahmen zur Spender:innenbindung
•    Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Nachlassteam und anderen relevanten Teams, um den Austausch von Wissen und Know-how zu fördern
•    Beitrag zur Erreichung der Ziele im Nachlassbereich
Profil
Ausbildung
•    Hochschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
•    Kenntnisse des Erbrechts von Vorteil
Erfahrung
•    Erfahrung in der Spender:innenbetreuung, in Fundraising, Kundenbeziehungsmanagement (CRM) oder im Aufbau von Bindungen zu Premiumkund:innen
•    Idealerweise Erfahrung in den Bereichen Stewardship, Philanthropie oder Majour Donors
•    Erfahrung bei einer NGO oder einer internationalen Organisation von Vorteil

Junior Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)
====================================




**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als «Junior Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine Rolle im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran

DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)
=================================




**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**




**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.




**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

* Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

* In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher




**Möchtest du ein DevOps\-Team von Grund auf mitgestalten und deine Erfahrungen einbringen? Suchst du ein stabiles Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen gehört werden?**

Dann freut sich **Thomas Lüthi** auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder auf deinen Anruf.

title: Propellant Chemist
description:
Description
About the role

Imagine being at the core of propulsion innovation, shaping the very materials that power our high performance rocket systems. As a Propellant Engineer at Destinus, you will lead the formulation, development, and characterization of solid rocket propellants and thermal protection materials for high-performance rocket motor applications. This role is strongly hands-on and combines materials science, process development, and analytical rigor to deliver reliable, high-quality propulsion materials.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

Develop and optimize solid rocket propellant formulations, balancing performance, mechanical properties, stability, and manufacturability.
Lead laboratory-scale mixing, casting, curing, and post-processing activities in accordance with defined safety and quality standards.
Define and implement characterization methodologies for propellant materials, including mechanical, thermal, rheological, ballistic, ablation and aging evaluations.
Establish and document standard test procedures, acceptance criteria, and data analysis methods for propellant & TPS materials development and qualification.
Support the definition of process parameters and quality control for propellant and TPS manufacturing, including mixing, degassing, casting, curing, and storage.
Analyse formulation trade-offs and drive improvements in performance, robustness, and reproducibility.
Support rocket motor development programs by correlating material properties to motor performance and structural behaviour and thermal environments.
Lead or support investigation of material anomalies, aging effects, or performance deviations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including formulation records, process specifications, characterization reports, and development plans.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, structures, manufacturing, and test teams to ensure seamless integration of propellant materials into motor designs.
Contribute to long-term technology development roadmaps for advanced propellant systems.
Requirements

What You’ll Need
BSc. or MSc. in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in solid rocket propellant development or closely related polymer/composite material systems.
Experience with propellant formulation, mixing, casting, and curing processes.
Strong understanding of polymer-bonded systems, composite materials, and viscoelastic behaviour.
Experience defining and conducting material characterization programs, including mechanical, thermal, and aging testing.
Familiarity with establishing standard operating procedures and structured development processes.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate material data into engineering decisions.
Strong documentation discipline and ability to work in a safety-critical environment.
Ability to work hands-on in laboratory and pilot-scale environments.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Fluency in English required; German is a plus.

Who You Are
You are a propulsion minded materials expert who feels at home in the lab and on the production floor. You understand polymer bonded propellants not just in theory but in practice, from formulation strategy to mixing, casting, curing, and final characterization. You are comfortable defining the technical path forward while also building the processes, documentation, and qualification methods that make materials flight ready and repeatable.

Benefits
Why Join Us?

The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

title: Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems (M&W)
description:
**As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.**

**We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, including protecting the environment, ensuring food safety, and helping find cures for cancer.**


**Job Description:**

**Join our Quality Control team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you will make meaningful contributions to our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.**

**As an Senior Scientist Electronic Laboratory Systems, you will perform technical support activities and validation exercise to ensure product quality in a GMP-regulated environment. You will work with analytical equipment and electronic laboratory systems, supporting the qualification, validation, operation, and lifecycle management of QC systems and applications.**


**Key Responsibilities:**

- Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot analytical laboratory equipment and electronic laboratory systems.
- Support qualification of analytical equipment and computerized system validation activities for QC laboratory systems.
- Generate, review, and maintain GxP documentation throughout the lifecycle of QC systems, equipment, and applications.
- Evaluate analytical data, document results accurately, and ensure compliance with applicable quality standards.
- Support investigations related to out-of-specification, out-of-expectation, deviations, change controls, and corrective and preventive actions.
- Provide timely technical support to QC laboratory units to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
- Support inspection and audit readiness activities, including gap assessments, remediation actions, and participation in customer or health authority inspections as needed.
- Contribute to the implementation of automated data flows, laboratory process improvements, and Practical Process Improvement initiatives.
- Support data integrity expectations by ensuring reliable, complete, accurate, and compliant laboratory records.
- Collaborate with Quality, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Science and Technology, Supply Chain, Maintenance and Facilities, Procurement, IT, and global laboratory systems teams.
- Adhere to cGMP, quality, EHSS, and site procedures.
- Actively contribute to continuous quality improvement, safety initiatives, deviation reporting, and near-miss follow-up.
- Demonstrate Thermo Fisher Scientific values through accountability, ethical behavior, customer focus, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.

**Required Qualifications:**

- BSc or MSc in Lifes Sciences (Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physics, Microbiology or equivalent)
- Or IT/Automation background with strong knowledge and experience in the pharma industry
- Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, quality systems, and laboratory compliance requirements.
- Significant experience in a laboratory environment, experience in IT (Programming or Database)
- Computerized System Validation (CSV) and pharma industry Experience in Lab execution Systems as SM LIMS, Chromeleon, Lab X, Empower, etc. is a benefit
- Demonstrated ability to analyze data and support investigations of out-of-specification or atypical results.
- Strong documentation skills and ability to follow written and verbal procedures accurately.
- Familiarity with laboratory information management systems and electronic laboratory systems.
- Knowledge of relevant regulatory standards, including ISO, FDA, USP, and EP expectations.
- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
