title: Nurse specialist in dementia care
description:
To primarily provide holistic, evidence-based best practice care to a private individual relating to all her needs in positive person-centred manner. These needs currently include having a diagnosis of dementia, age-related frailties and any other issues or health co-morbidities that may arise.

Essentially the post-holder will be required to:

- Assesses; plans, develops and implements programmes of care; provides advice; maintains associated records either manually or digitally;
- Carry out nursing procedures as required and in concordance with clinical guidelines;
- Provide clinical supervision to other staff.

The post holder will direct, coordinate and supervise, where appropriate, the work of other staff to promote best practice in relation to the care of the client with dementia. In the absence of the team leader, the post holder will provide cover to ensure effective delivery of care to the client. Any issues should be raised with the line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS / Essential requirements

- Swiss or EU passport (or Swiss working permit holder)
- Registered Nurse with valid NMC registration or European/Swiss equivalent.
- Nursing degree or equivalent.
- Best Practice in Dementia Training completion or working towards, ability to undertake this.
- Willingness to undergo specific dementia training ie Best Practice in Dementia Care, delivered in English.
- Additional qualifications in relation to dementia and dementia related topics including stress and distress training, meaningful activity, Sage and Thyme.
- Understanding of the Newcastle Model and/or PINCHME model of behaviour assessment.
- Willingness to develop dementia knowledge as part of CPD either independently or as provided by the Organisation.
- Specialist dementia qualification or additional studies in related areas.
- Understanding behaviour as a communication and good knowledge of non-pharmacological interventions and strategies.
- Experience in End of Life Care / Develop relevant clinical skills to address any developing co-morbidities and end-of-life care

QUALIFICATIONS / Additional requirements (may be utilised to benefit LHS)

- Moving and Handling Trainer
- Beauty/Massage Therapy
- Meaningful Activity

LANGUAGE / Essential

- Ability to communicate effectively using English.    English as first language (ideally mother tongue). Local dialect to client – Central Scotland.
- Excellent written communication in English.
- Due to the nature of FTL Dementia the language centres of the brain are affected. The inability to communicate effectively has a detrimental affect on LHS and their quality of life, increasing stress and distressed behaviour.

EXPERIENCE

Minimum 5 years’ experience working with people with dementia.
    
PERSONAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES

- Demonstrate excellent team working skills with the ability to work using own initiative.
- Effective listening, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with people and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
- Excellent time management skills.
- Working knowledge of basic technology.    
- Teaching skills for junior members of staff, family and other professionals.

SPECIFIC JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Being able to commit to working a shift pattern based in Buckinghamshire, UK and Switzerland for extended periods of time (preferably 10-14 days) / Necessity to travel with the client in UK.
- Unsociable hours are included this comes in the form of a sleepover arrangement alternating nights with another member of staff for the period of time ‘on shift’.
- May involve accompanying client to and from other venues as part of the duties.
- Be able to conduct and present themselves in a manner appropriate to the social standing of the client.
- Confidentiality must be always maintained both in line with NMC requirements as well as organisationally given the nature of the employer – a confidentiality agreement will be provided separately.
- Understanding the culture local to the client and family as dementia progresses earlier years are more prevalent and a lack of awareness or understanding can cause increased stress and distress which could lead to unnecessary pharmacological interventions.    
- Housekeeping is also a key aspect of this position.

title: Technical Advisor / Principal Architect, Office of the CTO
description:
Postulation uniquement en ligne - merci de mentionner sous source (ORP)

Kandou AI is redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our proprietary MIMO‑over‑copper technology powers a high‑performance, chiplet‑based AI memory fabric that delivers high bandwidth and ultra‑low latency at dramatically lower power. Our architecture represents a foundational shift in how next‑generation AI hardware is built.

We are seeking a Technical Advisor / Principal Architect to work directly with the CTO on the conception, modeling, and development of breakthrough communication and interconnect technologies.

This is a rare opportunity for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of theory, architecture, and silicon implementation — someone who wants to help shape the future of chip‑to‑chip, die‑to‑die, memory, and networking interconnects.

Role Overview:
You will partner closely with the CTO to explore, evaluate, and prototype next‑generation communication system architectures. This role spans research, modeling, algorithm development, system architecture, and early‑stage silicon feasibility. You will help translate theoretical concepts into implementable designs that can scale into real products.

What You Will Do:
Partner with the CTO to develop next-generation communication and interconnect architectures.
Explore novel signaling, coding, equalization, and system-level techniques.
Build models, simulations, and prototypes to validate architectural concepts.
Evaluate performance, power, latency, area, and manufacturability tradeoffs.
Translate research into silicon-ready architectures and intellectual property.
Identify emerging technologies and opportunities for competitive differentiation.
Provide technical leadership and guidance across research, architecture, and product teams

Required Qualifications:
Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field.
Strong background in digital communications and communication system fundamentals.
Deep understanding of information theory, coding, modulation, and signal processing.
Experience building mathematical models, simulations, or prototypes.
Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar environments.
Ability to work across abstraction levels — from theory to architecture to implementation.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; comfortable exploring unfamiliar domains.

Highly Desirable Experience (streamlined):
SerDes architecture, equalization, or wireline communications.
Coding theory, FEC, or advanced modulation schemes.
System‑level modeling (SystemC or equivalent).
Machine learning applied to communications.
Experience taking concepts from theory to silicon.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate:
Moves fluidly between mathematics, algorithms, architecture, and hardware.
Is willing and able to be hands-on when needed, diving into analysis, modeling, coding, simulation, debugging, or lab work to help move critical projects forward.
Is intellectually curious and thrives on open‑ended technical challenges.
Challenges assumptions and proposes unconventional approaches when needed.
Understands that elegant theory must ultimately translate into manufacturable silicon.

title: Learning Support Assistant 50 %
description:
Lien : https://www.eteach.com/job/learning-support-assistant-1566810

Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Learning Support Assistant
to join the school from: 24.08.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 05.08.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 480 students aged 7 -18 representing 70 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the senior school with a dedicated focus on Year 2-8 students.

The school wishes to appoint a teaching assistant for the junior school to work primarily with students in Years 7 and 8.  Experience of working in an international school context would be a distinct advantage. It is expected that this post will involve supporting approximately 20-30 hours per week. This is a term-time only position.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To support teaching staff in the development and education of pupils including the provision of specialist skills as appropriate.

Support for students (either individually or in groups)
Support the activities of individuals or groups, specifically those with EAL considerations.
Establish and maintain relationships with individual pupils and groups.
Contribute to Individual Education Plans as appropriate.
Support pupils during learning activities.
Promote pupils’ social and emotional development.
Contribute to the health and well-being of pupils.
Provide support for bilingual/multilingual pupils (where appropriate to the focus of the role).
Support children with specific needs (where appropriate to the focus of the role), for example, sensory and/or physical impairment, cognitive or learning difficulties, behavioural, emotional and social development needs, communication and interaction difficulties.
Support for Gifted and Talented pupils.
Support pupils with their literacy and numeracy skills.
Support pupils to access the curriculum.
Dealing with the personal care needs of children where appropriate in line with the guidance of the school.

Support for the teacher(s)
Observe and report on pupil performance.
Contribute to the planning and evaluation of learning activities.
Assist in preparing and maintaining the learning environment.
Contribute to the management of pupils’ behaviour.
Contribute to maintaining pupils’ records.
Support the maintenance of pupils’ safety and security.
Supervise the whole class for a short time in an emergency (normally for a period less than a whole lesson until the teacher returns or alternative arrangements are made) or for a very short period of planned absence for less than a whole lesson.
Undertake routine marking in line with the school policy.
Provide administrative support, e.g. produce worksheets, invigilate examinations, etc.

Support for the School
Support the development and effectiveness of team work within the school environment.
Develop and maintain working relationships with other professionals.
Liaise with parents as appropriate.
Review and develop your own professional practice.

Support for the curriculum
Support the use of information and communication technology in the classroom.
Have a responsibility for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people he/she is responsible for or comes into contact with.
To ensure tasks are carried out with due regard to Health and Safety.
To participate in appropriate professional development including adhering to the principle of appraisal/performance management.
To adhere to the ethos of Aiglon and promote the agreed vision and aims of the school while setting an example of personal integrity and professionalism.
Attendance at appropriate staff meetings, parents/open evenings, etc.
Any other duties as commensurate within the grade in order to ensure the smooth running of Aiglon.
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Deputy Head of the Junior School to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

description:
Senior Specialist, IT  
Senior Specialist, IT  
Place of work: Basel, Switzerland  
Employment rate: 50–100%  
Start date: 1 January 2027 or sooner  
Contract type: Permanent  
Other: Must be eligible to work in Switzerland  
Basel Institute on Governance  
The Basel Institute on Governance is a hands\-on centre of competence dedicated to promoting good governance and countering corruption for a more peaceful, just and sustainable world. Established in 2003 in Basel, Switzerland, the Institute works with partners worldwide to advance knowledge, practice and policy on anti\-corruption, asset recovery and business integrity. With field operations worldwide, it has some 150 staff covering 32 nationalities. The Basel Institute is an Associated Institute of the University of Basel.  
Job description  
The Senior Specialist, IT takes operational ownership of the Basel Institute’s IT infrastructure, security and identity management. Working closely with and deputising for the Head, IT and eLearning, the successful candidate will keep the Basel Institute’s systems secure, available and well\-documented, lead the day\-to\-day implementation of the IT Security and Operations Policy and help with the safe and effective adoption of new technologies, including AI. The Senior Specialist will also supervise and develop the Associate, IT.  
Key responsibilities  
Implement, maintain and monitor the Basel Institute’s IT Security and Operations Policy and support the disaster recovery and malware response plans.  
Maintain and monitor the IT infrastructure, including the Sophos firewall appliance, UniFi wireless network, Xerox printers, 3CX phone system, Synology NAS devices and the NextCloud shared drive.  
Manage users, authentication and access rights across Active Directory and Google Workspace, including onboarding and offboarding and regular access reviews.  
Provide and coordinate cybersecurity awareness training for staff, including onboarding and regular refresher training and act as a point of contact for reporting and responding to security incidents.  
Identify, evaluate and implement AI tools and solutions to improve IT operations and support their safe, compliant and well\-governed adoption across the Basel Institute.  
Supervise, mentor and develop the Associate, IT, coordinating day\-to\-day support and workload.  
Oversee IT asset management, backups and system monitoring, coordinate with external service providers and deputise for the Head, IT and eLearning as required.  
Provide first\-level IT support to staff alongside the Associate, IT, ensuring timely resolution and acting as the escalation point for more complex issues.  
Qualifications and skills  
University degree or equivalent vocational qualification in information technology, computer science or a related field.  
At least five years of experience in IT systems administration and infrastructure, ideally in a mixed on\-premises and cloud environment.  
Proven expertise in network and firewall administration (Sophos experience is an advantage), identity and access management (Active Directory, Google Workspace) as well as IT security.  
Relevant experience with UniFi Wi\-Fi, Synology NAS, NextCloud, 3CX telephony and remote management/monitoring tools, as well as experience supervising or mentoring colleagues, is an advantage.  
Proficient in Microsoft and Google Workspace administration.  
Experience in a major AI platform (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and the creation and management of skills, plugins, connectors, agents and MCP servers.  
Languages: Excellent English skills; a good command of German and proficiency in other languages are an advantage.  
Offer  
We offer an interesting and rewarding working environment with a proactive, dynamic and international team spirit. The work is both routine and varied, and offers scope for initiative and innovation. The salary is competitive.

Global Head of Education (f/m/d)
================================

### **About the ITI**

The ITI (International Team for Implantology) is the world's leading academic community in implant dentistry. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, we are an independent, non\-profit, member\-led organization uniting around 25,000 Fellows and Members across 40 Sections worldwide.

Built on four pillars — Science, Education, Leadership and Membership — the ITI sets the global standard for evidence\-based education and has invested heavily in research that improves treatment for patients everywhere. Our purpose is simple: *inspiring global excellence in implant dentistry for the benefit of the patient.*

### **The opportunity**

Are you ready to shape how the world learns implant dentistry? As Global Head of Education, you will own the ITI's education strategy and — in a small, entrepreneurial team — build and deliver it personally. This is a senior leadership role for someone who is equal parts strategist, builder and doer: you will set the direction and then roll up your sleeves to make it happen, every day.

You will keep the ITI the leading global authority in implant dentistry education, scale our education business and partner ecosystem across university\-based and private education, and grow the number of clinicians educated to the ITI Curriculum standard. You will also guide and support the high\-profile volunteers of the global ITI Education Committee, co\-creating strategy and content priorities with dentists and academics from dental schools and private practice alike.

### **What you will do**

**Strategy \& portfolio — own it and build it**

* **Set the direction.** Develop and deliver the global education strategy across university\-based and private education, aligned with the ITI's mission and growth goals.
* **Own the full portfolio, hands\-on.** ITI Curriculum, University Program, Treatment Guides, ITI Academy, study\-club and partner content, congress and course content.
* **Expand undergraduate education.** Lead train\-the\-trainer programs and a stronger service offering for universities.
* **Grow the partner ecosystem.** Build and roll out a partnership program for private education providers to spread ITI content and standards.


**Committee, volunteers \& stakeholders**

* **Be a trusted advisor.** Act as sparring partner to the Education Committee and its Chair; prepare decisions and co\-create direction with these high\-profile volunteers.
* **Energize the network.** Motivate and coordinate \~40 education volunteers worldwide who drive education in local Sections and countries.
* **Connect across the ecosystem.** Work closely with education colleagues in subsidiaries and Sections, and with KOLs, universities, providers and industry partners — including Straumann.
* **Represent the ITI.** At congresses, universities, partner meetings and scientific events.


**Content \& learning — personally in the detail**

* **Run the editorial engine.** Own the end\-to\-end process for educational content: editorial, video, e\-learning, presentations, courses and events.
* **Raise the bar on learning.** Drive quality and consistency across in\-person, blended and digital formats, and strengthen learning design and outcome measurement.
* **Grow the ITI Academy.** Develop our digital channels to increase reach, engagement and active usage, and shape the agendas of congresses and study clubs.


**Operations, budget \& performance**

* **Keep operations running.** Own the underlying processes — editorial, course management, partner management and governance.
* **Hold the numbers.** Full budget responsibility for the portfolio (top and bottom line); develop and recommend the budget to the CEO, and own pricing and partner models.
* **Track what matters.** Define and report on KPIs — learners and graduates, education touchpoints, active partners, active platform users and CSAT.
* **Lead the team.** Build and develop a small, hands\-on, entrepreneurial and results\-oriented education team.


### **What you bring**

* **Experience.** Min. 10 years in professional education in healthcare (corporate or comparable not\-for\-profit), with min. 5 years leading people in complex, global, matrixed organizations.
* **A track record of results.** Driving learner growth, engagement or partner impact through education — with hands\-on experience producing content and running programs, not only overseeing them.
* **Domain depth.** Dentistry or medical devices preferred; digital learning, university partnerships or professional societies a strong plus. Experience building education partner ecosystems is valued.
* **Strategic and entrepreneurial instincts.** The business acumen to build education models and sustainable portfolios, and the bias to action to turn vision into scalable execution.
* **Stakeholder confidence.** Diplomatic, persuasive communication with executives, scientific experts, volunteers, universities and industry partners across cultures.
* **Craft and judgement.** A solid grasp of learning design, digital/blended learning and outcome measurement, plus strong editorial judgement on scientific, medical and educational content.
* **Education \& languages.** Bachelor's or equivalent in business, education, dentistry, healthcare, life sciences or a related field. Fluent English (further languages an advantage); willingness to travel \~20%.


### **What we offer**

The chance to shape implant dentistry globally, alongside leading minds in the field, for the benefit of patients worldwide.A prestigious organization with 45\+ years in implant dentistry education and research, and a community of tens of thousands of space to create and shape, where ideas and opinions are truly hierarchies and a people\-centric, entrepreneurial , long\-term industry partners that provide stability and broader career perspectives.

### How to apply

We only accept direct applications submitted either through the application portal of this jobs platform or our own application portal. Use the following link to submit your application through the ITI portal:

[ITI Application Portal](<>)

We do not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

description:
Data Center Design Manager  


  











Data Center Design Manager
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Design Group**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager/Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Design Coordination and Development throughout the Project including Coordination of shop drawings**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.



 **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.
* Maintain the design management plan, responsibility matrix, deliverables register and programme. Align releases with procurement lead times, construction sequencing and the integrated project schedule.
* Coordinate excavation, temporary works interfaces, foundations and piling where required, concrete, steel, architecture, façades and roofing with equipment loads, installation sequences and building services.
* Integrate critical power and cooling systems, including utility interfaces, transformers, generators, UPS, distribution, cooling plant, pumps and CRAH/CRAC units, together with controls, fire protection, security and ICT pathways.
* Close interfaces for openings, sleeves, shafts, plinths, embedded items, support and fire stopping before construction release. Coordinate structural approvals, maintenance access and equipment replacement routes.
* Lead multidisciplinary reviews and BIM coordination. Resolve technical and spatial issues, record decisions and maintain controlled models, drawings and specifications in the common data environment.
* Manage consultant scopes, technical submittals, RFIs and review comments. Coordinate approved construction information and track overdue inputs, revisions and approvals.
* Integrate vendor and subcontractor design, including employer supplied equipment where applicable. Coordinate technical procurement inputs, long lead equipment interfaces and vendor changes.
* Coordinate compliance reviews and permit submissions with Swiss consultants, authorities and utilities, addressing applicable SIA standards, fire safety requirements and project obligations.
* Assess changes and value engineering with Commercial and Project Controls teams, identifying effects on cost, programme, resilience, safety and operating performance before approval.
* Support side teams with buildability and design issue resolution. Manage design risks, safe access, construction interfaces and incorporation of approved site changes.
* Coordinate with commissioning and operations teams on testability and maintainability. Close design issues arising from factory and site acceptance tests and integrated systems testing.
* Track completion of as\-built records and operation and maintenance documentation. Report design progress, unresolved risks and required decisions through handover.

title: Enterprise Data & Systems Architect 100%
description:
Are you a systems architect or senior engineer who has built the digital backbone of a manufacturing or high-tech company, ready to own it end-to-end? At Lightium, we are building next-generation photonic integrated circuits (PICs) based on thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN), and we are looking for an Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to become the technical backbone of our data platform and enterprise systems.

Position Summary
We seek a hands-on Enterprise Data & Systems Architect to own the technical architecture of our data infrastructure, automation and digital systems. The ownership spans from database architecture and data warehouse to PLM, ERP and MES systems, as well as test automation, serving both R&D and growing production flow. As part of the Operations team, you will drive the data and systems strategy, own the integration between tools and data infrastructure, keeping the landscape coherent and lean as we scale from pilot to volume production. You will be managing and mentoring a small team of specialists ranging from DevOps to Data Scientists and Automation Engineers.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Systems Architecture & Strategy: Own the architecture and roadmap for Lightium’s data platform, enterprise systems, and supporting infrastructure as we scale from pilot to volume. Ensure that decisions across the data warehouse, PLM, ERP, MES, and HW/SW infrastructure reinforce one another rather than compete, and translate manufacturing and business needs into a coherent, pragmatic systems strategy that ensures data traceability across the company and across multiple locations and departments. Build and maintain high level dashboards that allows both operations and leadership teams to track KPI. Be responsible for all the cloud computing and cloud storage solutions, including Azure, AWS, Google Computing (GC) to ensure a cost-effective and scalable operations for both simulations, data analysis and data storage.

Data & Analytics Platform: Own the database and data-warehouse architecture and the modeling of test and manufacturing data, scaling it to support higher production volumes. Design, build, and operate the databases, data pipelines, transformation and orchestration, and lakehouse behind it on a modern data stack. Set the data contracts, naming conventions, and quality standards that keep data trustworthy and traceable as volume grows, and ensure the platform powers reliable analytics, BI, reporting, and internal tools at scale.

Data Security, Governance & Compliance: Own IT and data security and governance across the platform: access control (including external and internal Tier-based access), managing data encryption in transit and at rest, backups and disaster recovery, and clear ownership of who can access what. Align the systems and data landscape with the relevant standards (ISO 9001 quality management and ISO/IEC 27001 information security) and design the access and data-segregation controls that ensures confidentiality, and support export-control compliance (ITAR, US EAR, and the Swiss Goods Control Act / dual-use regulations) when handling sensitive PIC technical data.

Enterprise Systems & Product Lifecycle: Own Aras Innovator (PLM) and the ERP (Oracle NetSuite) implementation, including ongoing rollout, configuration, and the integration between the two. Drive end-to-end product and document lifecycle traceability, from design through to manufacturing, measurements, reporting and shipment, and keep master data consistent and clean across systems.

MES Selection & Implementation: Scout the market for a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) platform that fits both R&D (with high flexibility) and production (with high scalability), and run the full supplier tender through to vendor selection. Lead the subsequent implementation and integration of the MES with PLM, ERP, and the data platform, so that process steps, run data, and traceability flow end-to-end as production scales.

Test Automation & Tool Integration: Own the automated wafer-scale test software built on OpenTAP, from architecture and build through production rollout. Define and maintain the data-exchange protocols between tools and systems, connecting PLM, ERP, test, MES, and the data warehouse, and partner with process and test engineering to keep automation reliable and scalable as production volume ramps.

Infrastructure, Vendors & Continuous Improvement: Own the reliability, security, and scaling of core infrastructure (Linux servers, virtualization, containerized services, object storage, and backups), from the lakehouse and storage layers to application hosting and manufacturing-adjacent systems, and manage projects, contracts, and SLAs with external IT vendors and managed-service providers. Document architecture as living references, support the colleagues who use the systems day to day, and continuously improve how data and digital tools serve the company.

Technical Guidance & Mentorship: Act as the technical reference and architect for the wider engineering community, setting the direction, standards, and best practices that automation engineers, data and analytics engineers, DevOps engineers, and interns. Manage and mentor a small team of specialists, and guide them in their day-to-day work, and support the hiring process for these roles as the team grows around the architecture you define.

What You’ll Bring
Educational Background: A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field, with a strong track record in enterprise or solutions architecture, ideally in a manufacturing or semiconductor environment. You have ideally designed and built enterprise systems architectures from scratch.

Technical Expertise: Hands-on experience with PLM (Aras Innovator or similar) and ERP systems, including their implementation and integration. A track record leading automated/robotic production or testing lines, preferably in a semiconductor industry or similar. A strong database and data-engineering background (database and data-model design, data pipelines, transformation and orchestration, and data quality), hands-on with modern lakehouse and data platforms such as Databricks, Apache Iceberg, and Trino, and comfortable across both cloud and on-prem infrastructure, including containers, object storage, and lakehouse architectures. A solid grasp of data security, encryption, backups, and access control. Vendor and contract management experience, including negotiating SLAs with managed-service providers. Familiarity with data-relevant standards (ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001) and export-control regimes (ITAR, US EAR, Swiss dual-use / Goods Control Act) is a strong asset. Proficiency in modern AI solutions.

Mindset: Pragmatic and lean by instinct, happy to architect and to build with your own hands, and to solve problems through smart integration and vendor orchestration rather than headcount. People-leadership experience, with a track record of hiring, managing and mentoring technical staff. A strong communicator, able to translate manufacturing and business needs into technical strategy for executive leadership, and at home in a fast-moving startup.

Languages: Fluency in English is required. German or French is a bonus.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including an employee stock option plan (ESOP), fully-covered Pillar Two, and generous vacation.

A unique opportunity to lead a cutting-edge manufacturing initiative in the rapidly growing field of photonics.

A collaborative and innovative work environment where your contributions will shape the future of telecommunications, datacom, and beyond.

Final Thoughts
We'd love to hear from you if you're passionate about building new tech from the ground up and thrive in a collaborative and result-driven environment. Become a key player in an early-phase startup and join a motivated, and energetic team. You will have the unique opportunity to create, grow, and develop your professional skills at a fast pace. Lightium is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 **Description of the company**





Flexsis is a company of the Interiman Group, one of the leading providers of personnel services in Switzerland. Thanks to our solid expertise as well as the competencies within the Interiman Group, we offer tailored solutions in personnel consulting.



For our client **Roche** in **Kaiseraugst**, we are looking for a reliable and motivated (m/f/d)



 **Network and Capability Manager**



Start Date: ASAP



Latest Possible Start Date:



Planned Duration of Employment: 12 month



Extension: expected extension for another 6\-12 months depending on the situation



Workplace: Kaiseraugst



Workload: 100%



Home Office: Hybrid. 3 days on site 2 days HO



Travel: Yes this is possible, but it will be maybe up to 3\-4 trips a year .

 **Role \& Responsibilities**





* You are responsible for overseeing and optimizing the distribution network (\>100k shipments per year) to enable timely, reliable and efficient delivery for all global Roche/Genentech clinical trials. Therefore you partner closely with internal stakeholders (Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality), customers (Clinical Operations) and external partners (3PLs, LSPs, etc.)
* You contribute and execute the network \& capabilities chapter strategy, aligning with the overall distribution strategy. This incl. future network and capability readiness, build up of new locations, and a strong emphasis on Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
* You oversee, manage and optimize distribution costs and spend (\>50m CHF/year).
* You drive best practices, standardization, and optimization of distribution network processes in collaboration with Business Capability Leads (BCLs), QA ensuring supply chain reliability.
* You co\-create and execute objectives for the global network \& capabilities chapter, enabling continuous improvements and cultural transition towards a self\-managed team and organization.
* You ensure the overall compliance of the distribution network according to GxP and GCP standards.
 **Candidate Profile**





* You hold a degree (BA, MS, MBA) in a technical, business, or supply chain field or possess relevant experience; certifications like APICS, SCOR, Operational Excellence, Six Sigma, or Lean training are a plus.
* You have a strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain management, including warehouse and transportation management, logistics, and regulatory requirements for clinical trials.
* You bring relevant GXP experience
* You possess excellent knowledge of clinical supply chain distribution processes, Supplier Relationship management incl. negotiations \& industry best practices, and the tools and systems needed to enable operational excellence.
* You have (min. 6 years) 10\+ years of operational experience in supply chain, distribution, planning, and/or manufacturing, with significant expertise in clinical supply chain (distribution) management.
